<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Attacks deal @AttackAoERatio@ damage to enemies adjacent to the target.

Ignited enemies take @IgniteMaxHealthDamage@ max Health physical damage per second. Replace this ability with Flame Breath and immediately cast it.

<Bright>Flame Breath:</Bright>  Spew fire at the most enemies in a line through the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinimumDamageThreshold@.) <Bright>Grab n' Throw:</Bright> Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to them and @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.

TFT11_Encounter_ChoiceItem_TradeGoldForC.name: Trade @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT11_Encounter_ChoiceItem_GoldForComponent_GoldAmount@ gold for a random component. You currently have @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT11_Encounter_ChoiceItem_GoldForComponent_CurrentGold@ gold.

TFT11_Encounter_ChoiceItem_UnitBuffs2Cos.name: All of your @Cost@-cost champions gain @Health@ Health and @AS*100@% Attack Speed.

TFT11_Encounter_ChoiceItem_UnitBuffs3Cos.name: All of your @Cost@-cost champions gain @Health@ Health and @AS*100@% Attack Speed.

TFT11_Encounter_ChoiceItem_UnitBuffs4Cos.name: All of your @Cost@-cost champions gain @Health@ Health and @AS*100@% Attack Speed.

TFT11_Item_InkshadowHorse.desc: Whenever the holder acquires a new target they run quickly to and briefly stun them, dealing @Damage@ magic damage, and double the stats from this item for @BuffDuration@ seconds.
TFT11_Item_InkshadowHorse.name: Tattoo of Force

TFT11_Item_InkshadowOx.desc: Attacks heal the holder for @HealthRatio*100@% of their max Health and deal the same amount as bonus magic damage.
TFT11_Item_InkshadowOx.name: Tattoo of Vitality

TFT11_Item_InkshadowPig.desc: Gain a @HealthShieldRatio*100@% Shield after casting the first time each combat. When it breaks, grant @AllyShieldRatio*100@% of this shield amount to the 2 nearest allies.
TFT11_Item_InkshadowPig.name: Tattoo of Protection

TFT11_Item_InkshadowRat.desc: Every 3rd attack fires bolts at the 2 lowest percent health enemies which deal @ADPercent@% Attack Damage as physical damage.
TFT11_Item_InkshadowRat.name: Tattoo of Bombardment

TFT11_Item_InkshadowSnake.desc:
Damage applies a toxin that deals an additional @DamageRatio*100@% of that damage over @Duration@ seconds and @HealingReductionPct@% Wounds the target.

Wound: Reduces healing received
TFT11_Item_InkshadowSnake.name: Tattoo of Toxin

TFT11_Item_InkshadowTiger.desc: Deal @BonusRatio*100@% bonus damage to targets below half health. On takedown, gain @AttackSpeedPercent@% attack speed for @Duration@ seconds.
TFT11_Item_InkshadowTiger.name: Tattoo of Fury

TFT11_Item_ThiefsGlovesSupport.desc:
Each round: Equip 2 random Support items.

[Consumes 3 item slots.]
@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT_BindOnEquipTRA@
TFT11_Item_ThiefsGlovesSupport.name: Accomplice's Gloves

TFT11_Storyweaver3_AP.desc: Grant Kayle and adjacent allies in the same row @APAmt@ Ability Power at the start of combat.
TFT11_Storyweaver3_AP.name: Talisman of Might

TFT11_Storyweaver3_AS.desc: Grant Kayle and adjacent allies in the same row @ASAmt*100@% Attack Speed at the start of combat.
TFT11_Storyweaver3_AS.name: Talisman of Speed

TFT11_Storyweaver3_Support.desc: Kayle's damaging attacks and abilities @ResistPercent*100@% <TFTKeyword>Shred</TFTKeyword> and <TFTKeyword>Sunder</TFTKeyword> enemies hit for @Duration@ seconds.
TFT11_Storyweaver3_Support.name: Talisman of Aid

TFT11_Storyweaver5_AP.desc: Kayle's Ability hits a wider area and deals @APAmt*100@% more damage.
TFT11_Storyweaver5_AP.name: Scroll of Force

TFT11_Storyweaver5_AS.desc: Attacks grant Kayle @ASAmt*100@% stacking Attack Speed.
TFT11_Storyweaver5_AS.name: Scroll of Haste

TFT11_Storyweaver7_AP.desc: Kayle deals @DamageAmpPercent*100@% more damage. When she casts, she fires two waves.
TFT11_Storyweaver7_AP.name: Tome of Power

TFT11_Storyweaver7_AS.desc: Kayle deals @DamageAmpPercent*100@% more damage. Her attacks now hit in a @HexRadius@-hex radius around the target
TFT11_Storyweaver7_AS.name: Tome of Swiftness

TFT11_Storyweaver7_Support.desc: Every @Duration@ seconds, revive the strongest ally that hasn't been revived yet at @HPPercent*100@% of their maximum Health.
TFT11_Storyweaver7_Support.name: Tome of Mending

TFT12_Doodad_Test001.desc:
Your team gains @BaseHP@ Health. Gain another @BonusHPPer5MissingHealth@ Health and @OmnivampPercentPer5MissingHealth*100@% Omnivamp per 5 missing player health.
(Omnivamp: healing for a percent of damage dealt)
TFT12_Doodad_Test001.name: Vampirism I

TFT12_Doodad_Test002.desc:
Your team gains @BaseHP@ Health. Gain another @BonusHPPer5MissingHealth@ Health and @OmnivampPercentPer5MissingHealth*100@% Omnivamp per 5 missing player health.
(Omnivamp: healing for a percent of damage dealt)
TFT12_Doodad_Test002.name: Void Heart

TFT12_Item_Arcana_Signifier.desc:
Use this on an Arcana champion to change Arcana's effect to theirs.

Ahri: Gain Ability Power for each 3-star champion.
Hecarim: Units holding items gain Damage Reduction and Attack Damage.
Tahm Kench: Gain Health for each active trait.
Xerath: Abilities deal bonus true damage for each Charm purchased.
Emblem: Gain Damage Amp for each Spatula item equipped.
TFT12_Item_Arcana_Signifier.name: Arcana Signifier

TFT12_Item_Bound_LightSnack.desc:
Use this on a Briar to grant her @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT12_BoundHealthGain@ %i:scaleHealth% in exchange for @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT12_BoundHealthCost@ of your player health.

In Choncc's Treasure, this item is improved at Stage 3-1 and 4-1.

[Consumable - This item disappears when used.]
TFT12_Item_Bound_LightSnack.name: A Light Snack

TFT12_Item_Faerie_Armor.desc:
Gain @HealShieldPower*100@% increased healing and shielding. Heal for @QueenHealRatio*100@% of the Queen's damage dealt.

Only Faeries can hold this item.
Bench the champion to remove it.
TFT12_Item_Faerie_Armor.name: Queenguard's Armor

TFT12_Item_Faerie_ArmorRadiant.desc:
Gain @HealShieldPower*100@% increased healing and shielding. Heal for @QueenHealRatio*100@% of the Queen's damage dealt.

Only Faeries can hold this item.
Bench the champion to remove it.
TFT12_Item_Faerie_ArmorRadiant.name: Armor of Eternal Devotion

TFT12_Item_Faerie_QueensCrown.desc:
After dealing damage @MaxNumStacks@ times, gain @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT12_Faerie_DamageAmp@% %i:scaleDA% for the rest of combat.

Only Faeries can hold this item.
Bench the champion to remove it.
TFT12_Item_Faerie_QueensCrown.name: Faerie Queen's Crown

TFT12_Item_Faerie_QueensCrownRadiant.desc:
After dealing damage @MaxNumStacks@ times, gain @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT12_Faerie_DamageAmp@% %i:scaleDA% for the rest of combat.

After dealing damage @RadiantMaxStacks@ times, gain @RadiantMaxHealth*100@% maximum Health, @RadiantOmnivamp*100@% Omnivamp, and @RadiantDamageAmp*100@% damage amp.

Only Faeries can hold this item.
Bench the champion to remove it.
TFT12_Item_Faerie_QueensCrownRadiant.name: Eternal Monarch's Crown

TFT12_Item_MilioThreeStar_CursedGuinsoos.desc: The holder of this item sets their attack speed cap to @ASCap@ and cannot gain mana or cast. Every time they are attacked, the attacker gains <TFTBonus>@BonusAttackSpeed*100@%</TFTBonus> Attack Speed.
TFT12_Item_MilioThreeStar_CursedGuinsoos.name: Cursed Guinsoo's Rageblade

TFT12_Item_MilioThreeStar_CursedHextechG.desc: The holder deals @NegativeDamageAmp*100@% less damage. They also take @DamageRatio*100@% of their max health as true damage per second, and heal Milio for the same amount.
TFT12_Item_MilioThreeStar_CursedHextechG.name: Cursed Hextech Gunblade

TFT12_Item_MilioThreeStar_CursedQuicksil.desc: The holder of this item is stunned. This effect ends when they die.
TFT12_Item_MilioThreeStar_CursedQuicksil.name: Cursed Quicksilver

TFT13_AnotherAnomaly_Item.desc: The holder gains your Anomaly evolution.
TFT13_AnotherAnomaly_Item.name: Portable Anomaly

TFT13_Augment_AGoldenFind.desc: Champions evolved by the Anomaly drop @GoldPerRequirement@ gold every @NumKillsRequirement@ kills. Gain @FreeRerolls@ free rerolls.
TFT13_Augment_AGoldenFind.name: A Golden Find

TFT13_Augment_Academy.desc: Whenever you build an item, gain a completed item anvil instead. That anvil always offers an Academy item and the item built. Gain @NumItems@ random components. Gain a Lux and an Ezreal.
TFT13_Augment_Academy.name: Academic Research

TFT13_Augment_AcademyCrest.desc: Gain an Academy Emblem and a Leona.
TFT13_Augment_AcademyCrest.name: Academy Crest

TFT13_Augment_AcademyCrown.desc: Gain an Academy Emblem and a random sponsored item.
TFT13_Augment_AcademyCrown.name: Academy Crown

TFT13_Augment_Ambusher.desc: Ambusher kills have a chance to drop loot, scaling with Critical Strike Chance. The value of the loot given can also critically strike, granting even more loot. Gain a Camille and a Powder.
TFT13_Augment_Ambusher.name: Loot Explosion

TFT13_Augment_AmbusherCrest.desc: Gain an Ambusher Emblem and a Camille.
TFT13_Augment_AmbusherCrest.name: Ambusher Crest

TFT13_Augment_AmbusherCrown.desc: Gain an Ambusher Emblem, a Hand of Justice, and a Camille.
TFT13_Augment_AmbusherCrown.name: Ambusher Crown

TFT13_Augment_AnotherAnomaly.desc: After the Anomaly round on 4-6, gain an item that duplicates the chosen Anomaly Effect onto the equipped champion.
TFT13_Augment_AnotherAnomaly.name: Another Anomaly

TFT13_Augment_Artillerist.desc: Artillerist rockets deal @IncreasedRocketDamage*100@% increased damage. Every @RocketDamageThreshold@ rockets your Artillerists fire, gain a Collector (max @MaxItems@). Gain a Tristana and Urgot. (Rockets Fired: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT13_Augment_Artillerist_TotalDamage@)
TFT13_Augment_Artillerist.name: Rocket Collection

TFT13_Augment_ArtilleristCrest.desc: Gain an Artillerist Emblem and a Tristana.
TFT13_Augment_ArtilleristCrest.name: Artillerist Crest

TFT13_Augment_ArtilleristCrown.desc: Gain an Artillerist Emblem, a Runaan's Hurricane, and a Tristana.
TFT13_Augment_ArtilleristCrown.name: Artillerist Crown

TFT13_Augment_ArtilleristPlus.desc: Artillerist rockets deal @IncreasedRocketDamage*100@% increased damage. Every @RocketDamageThreshold@ rockets your Artillerists fire, gain a Collector (max @MaxItems@). Gain a Tristana and Urgot. (Rockets Fired: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT13_Augment_Artillerist_TotalDamage@)
TFT13_Augment_ArtilleristPlus.name: Rocket Collection+

TFT13_Augment_Automata.desc: When an Automata champion fires their blast, they fire a second blast at the closest enemy dealing @Percentage*100@% of the original damage. Gain an Amumu and Nocturne.
TFT13_Augment_Automata.name: Fractured Crystals

TFT13_Augment_AutomataCrest.desc: Gain an Automata Emblem and a Nocturne.
TFT13_Augment_AutomataCrest.name: Automata Crest

TFT13_Augment_AutomataCrown.desc: Gain an Automata Emblem, a Guardbreaker, and a Nocturne.
TFT13_Augment_AutomataCrown.name: Automata Crown

TFT13_Augment_BlueCarry.desc: Gain a Powder. Your strongest Powder's explosion radius is increased by two hexes, has different damage falloff, but deals @TOOLTIPONLYFriendlyDamage@% damage to ALLIES.
TFT13_Augment_BlueCarry.name: This WILL Work

TFT13_Augment_Bruiser.desc: Every @RefreshSeconds@ seconds, Bruisers deal @SlamPercentHealth*100@% bonus max Health bonus physical damage on their next attack. Gain a Steb and a Trundle.
TFT13_Augment_Bruiser.name: Heavily Smash

TFT13_Augment_BruiserCrest.desc: Gain a Bruiser Emblem and a Sett.
TFT13_Augment_BruiserCrest.name: Bruiser Crest

TFT13_Augment_BruiserCrown.desc: Gain a Bruiser Emblem, a Redemption, and a Sett.
TFT13_Augment_BruiserCrown.name: Bruiser Crown

TFT13_Augment_Cabal.desc: Every @NumTakedownsPerStack@ takedowns by Black Rose champions or Sion grant Sion permanent @SionADPercentPerStack*100@% Attack Damage and @SionHealthPerStack@ Max Health. Gain 3 Black Rose champions. (Stacks: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT13_Augment_Cabal_NumStacks@)
TFT13_Augment_Cabal.name: Forbidden Magic

TFT13_Augment_CabalCrown.desc: Gain a Black Rose Emblem, a Spear of Shojin, and a Cassiopeia.
TFT13_Augment_CabalCrown.name: Black Rose Crown

TFT13_Augment_ChainsawCarry.desc: Gain 2 Rennis. Your strongest Renni's Ability costs @TOOLTIPManaReduction@ less and causes her to lunge towards the farthest enemy within @TOOLTIPHexDistance@ hexes, dealing @TOOLTIPAbilityDamage*100@% damage to the target and reduced damage to enemies in her path.
TFT13_Augment_ChainsawCarry.name: Brutal Revenge

TFT13_Augment_Chembaron.desc: Everytime you choose to save your Shimmer on a Black Market, heal @Heal@ player health and gain @Gold@ gold. Gain a Renni.
TFT13_Augment_Chembaron.name: War for the Undercity

TFT13_Augment_ChembaronCrest.desc: Gain a Chem-Baron Emblem and a Renata Glasc.
TFT13_Augment_ChembaronCrest.name: Chem-Baron Crest

TFT13_Augment_ChembaronCrown.desc: Gain a Chem-Baron Emblem, a Nashor's Tooth, and a Smeech.
TFT13_Augment_ChembaronCrown.name: Chem-Baron Crown

TFT13_Augment_Conqueror.desc: Conquerors execute enemies below @BaseExecuteThreshold@% Health. When they do, they gain @ArmorandMagicResist@ Armor and Magic Resist for the rest of combat. Gain a Darius and Draven.
TFT13_Augment_Conqueror.name: Noxian Guillotine

TFT13_Augment_ConquerorCrest.desc: Gain a Conqueror Emblem and a Rell.
TFT13_Augment_ConquerorCrest.name: Conqueror Crest

TFT13_Augment_ConquerorCrown.desc: Gain a Conqueror Emblem, a Last Whisper, and a Rell.
TFT13_Augment_ConquerorCrown.name: Conqueror Crown

TFT13_Augment_Dominator.desc: Dominators gain @ShieldPercentAS*100@% Attack Speed while shielded. When a Dominator gets a kill, all Dominators gain @ShieldAmount@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Gain a Cassiopeia.
TFT13_Augment_Dominator.name: Domination

TFT13_Augment_DominatorCrest.desc: Gain a Dominator Emblem and a Blitzcrank.
TFT13_Augment_DominatorCrest.name: Dominator Crest

TFT13_Augment_DominatorCrown.desc: Gain a Dominator Emblem, a Protector's Vow, and a Blitzcrank.
TFT13_Augment_DominatorCrown.name: Dominator Crown

TFT13_Augment_Enforcer.desc: Enforcer champions gain @BonusAD*100@% Attack Damage. Every @WantedEnemyBreakpoint@ Wanted enemy deaths grant @BonusGoldAmount@ gold. Gain a Steb and Maddie.
TFT13_Augment_Enforcer.name: Law Enforcement

TFT13_Augment_EnforcerCrown.desc: Gain an Enforcer Emblem, an Infinity Edge, and a Maddie.
TFT13_Augment_EnforcerCrown.name: Enforcer Crown

TFT13_Augment_Experiment.desc: Experiments gain @Health*100@% Health and grant a special hex. The Experiment in the hex is killed on combat start, granting their Experiment bonus to other laboratory hexes. Gain 3 Experiment champions.
TFT13_Augment_Experiment.name: The Mutation Survives

TFT13_Augment_ExperimentCrest.desc: Gain an Experiment Emblem and an Urgot.
TFT13_Augment_ExperimentCrest.name: Experiment Crest

TFT13_Augment_ExperimentCrown.desc: Gain an Experiment Emblem, a Bloodthirster, and an Urgot.
TFT13_Augment_ExperimentCrown.name: Experiment Crown

TFT13_Augment_Family.desc: If at least @MinNumFamilyMembers@ Family members are alive after @TimeRequirement@ seconds in combat or at the end of combat, gain a random copy of a Vander, Powder, or Violet. Gain a Powder and Violet.
TFT13_Augment_Family.name: Welcome to the Playground

TFT13_Augment_FamilyCrown.desc: Gain a Family Emblem and a Redemption.
TFT13_Augment_FamilyCrown.name: Family Crown

TFT13_Augment_Firelight.desc: Firelight champions gain @FirelightBonusAD*100@% Attack Damage and @FirelightBonusAP@ Ability Power when they start a Firelight dash. They gain another @Bonus@% for every hex traveled that combat. Gain a Scar and Zeri.
TFT13_Augment_Firelight.name: Aerial Warfare

TFT13_Augment_FirelightCrest.desc: Gain a Firelight Emblem and a Zeri.
TFT13_Augment_FirelightCrest.name: Firelight Crest

TFT13_Augment_FirelightCrown.desc: Gain a Firelight Emblem, a Protector's Vow, and a Scar.
TFT13_Augment_FirelightCrown.name: Firelight Crown

TFT13_Augment_FishCarry.desc: Gain a Steb. Your strongest Steb's Ability's Mana cost is reduced by @ManaReduction@, but no longer heals. Steb's spell grants @TOOLTIPONLYOmnivamp@% Omnivamp and strikes 3 times, each dealing @TOOLTIPONLYModifiedDamage*100@%.
TFT13_Augment_FishCarry.name: Combat Medic

TFT13_Augment_Formswapper.desc: While you field 2 of the same Form Swapper in different forms, both gain @BonusStats@ Ability Power, Armor, and Magic Resist, and @BonusStats@% Attack Damage. When you 3-star a Form Swapper, gain a 2-star copy. Gain a Swain and Gangplank.
TFT13_Augment_Formswapper.name: Why Not Both?

TFT13_Augment_Grant6Cost_MissMage.desc:
Gain a Blue Buff. After starting a round with @RoundGold@ gold and winning a player combat, gain a Mel and a Hextech Gunblade.

Tasks can be completed in any order.
TFT13_Augment_Grant6Cost_MissMage.name: A Change Of Fate

TFT13_Augment_Grant6Cost_Viktor.desc:
Gain an Adaptive Helm. After you upgrade @NumUpgrades@ champions, gain a Viktor and a Jeweled Gauntlet.
(Current: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT13_Augment_GrantViktor@)
TFT13_Augment_Grant6Cost_Viktor.name: Glorious Evolution

TFT13_Augment_Grant6Cost_Warwick.desc:
Gain a Bloodthirster. After you deal @PlayerDamage@ damage to other players, gain a Warwick and a Sterak's Gage.
(Current: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT13_Augment_WarwickDamageCount@)
TFT13_Augment_Grant6Cost_Warwick.name: What You Really Are

TFT13_Augment_GuidedAnomaly.desc: Gain @FreeAnomalyRerolls@ free Anomaly rerolls. Unused rerolls are converted to gold. Gain @InitialGold@ gold now.
TFT13_Augment_GuidedAnomaly.name: Guided Anomaly

TFT13_Augment_IreliaCarry.desc: Gain an Irelia. Your strongest Irelia gains @TOOLTIPBonusAS*100@% Attack Speed and gains a brand new Ability that dashes her between two targets, dealing physical damage to both.
TFT13_Augment_IreliaCarry.name: Blade Dance

TFT13_Augment_PitFighter.desc: Pit Fighters permanently gain @ADPerLoss*100@% Attack Damage if they lost the last combat. If they won, gain @HealthPerWin@ Health instead. Gain an Urgot.
TFT13_Augment_PitFighter.name: Training Arc

TFT13_Augment_PitFighterCrest.desc: Gain a Pit Fighter Emblem and an Urgot.
TFT13_Augment_PitFighterCrest.name: Pit Fighter Crest

TFT13_Augment_PitFighterCrown.desc: Gain a Pit Fighter Emblem, a Sterak's Gage, and a Gangplank.
TFT13_Augment_PitFighterCrown.name: Pit Fighter Crown

TFT13_Augment_PrimeCarry.desc: Gain a Vander. Your strongest Vander gains a brand new Ability that no longer grants resistances, but deals @TOOLTIPBonusDamage*100@% increased damage and punches the target backwards, dealing @TOOLTIPONLYSplashPerc*100@% of the original damage to all enemies hit.
TFT13_Augment_PrimeCarry.name: Gloves Off

TFT13_Augment_Quickstriker.desc: Combat start and every @TimeBetweenProcs@ seconds, all Quickstrikers attack @AttackSpeed*100@% faster for @BuffDuration@ seconds. Gain a Nocturne and Akali.
TFT13_Augment_Quickstriker.name: Adrenaline Burst

TFT13_Augment_QuickstrikerCrest.desc: Gain a Quickstriker Emblem and an Akali.
TFT13_Augment_QuickstrikerCrest.name: Quickstriker Crest

TFT13_Augment_QuickstrikerCrown.desc: Gain a Quickstriker Emblem, a Guinsoo's Rageblade, and a Nocturne.
TFT13_Augment_QuickstrikerCrown.name: Quickstriker Crown

TFT13_Augment_Rebel.desc: When the first @NumOfUnits@ Rebels die each combat, summon a copy of themselves that is one-star lower with @ReducedHealth@ less Health. Gain an Akali and an Irelia.
TFT13_Augment_Rebel.name: Paint the Town Blue

TFT13_Augment_RebelCrest.desc: Gain a Rebel Emblem and an Akali.
TFT13_Augment_RebelCrest.name: Rebel Crest

TFT13_Augment_RebelCrown.desc: Gain a Rebel Emblem, a Jeweled Gauntlet, and an Akali.
TFT13_Augment_RebelCrown.name: Rebel Crown

TFT13_Augment_Scrap.desc:
Every @NumScrapItemsConverted@ components Scrap champions convert, gain a random component (max @MaxComponents@). Gain a Powder and a Trundle.

Converted: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT13_Augment_Scrap_NumComponents@/@NumScrapItemsConverted@
TFT13_Augment_Scrap.name: Top of the Scrap Heap

TFT13_Augment_ScrapCrest.desc: Gain a Scrap Emblem and a Ziggs.
TFT13_Augment_ScrapCrest.name: Scrap Crest

TFT13_Augment_ScrapCrown.desc: Gain a Scrap Emblem, a Ziggs, and @NumComponents@ random components.
TFT13_Augment_ScrapCrown.name: Scrap Crown

TFT13_Augment_Sentinel.desc: Sentinels gain @PercGain*100@% bonus Armor and Magic Resist. Every @Interval@ seconds, their next attack deals @ResistToDamageRatio*100@% of their total resistances as magic damage. Gain a Loris.
TFT13_Augment_Sentinel.name: Shield Bash

TFT13_Augment_SentinelCrest.desc: Gain a Sentinel Emblem and a Rell.
TFT13_Augment_SentinelCrest.name: Sentinel Crest

TFT13_Augment_SentinelCrown.desc: Gain a Sentinel Emblem, a Crownguard, and a Loris.
TFT13_Augment_SentinelCrown.name: Sentinel Crown

TFT13_Augment_SingedCarry.desc: Gain a Singed. Your strongest Singed cannot attack but constantly runs, leaving a poison trail dealing magic damage over time. His Ability will always target himself and instead grants @TOOLTIPONLYOmnivamp@% Omnivamp and Move Speed.
TFT13_Augment_SingedCarry.name: Mad Chemist

TFT13_Augment_Sniper.desc: Snipers gain +@DamageAmp@% Damage Amp for each round fought from the same starting hex (Maximum +@MaxAmp@%). Gain a Zeri.
TFT13_Augment_Sniper.name: Sniper's Nest

TFT13_Augment_SniperCrest.desc: Gain a Sniper Emblem and a Zeri.
TFT13_Augment_SniperCrest.name: Sniper Crest

TFT13_Augment_SniperCrown.desc: Gain a Sniper Emblem, an Infinity Edge, and a Zeri.
TFT13_Augment_SniperCrown.name: Sniper Crown

TFT13_Augment_Sorcerer.desc: When Sorcerers die, they deal @DeathPercentage*100@% of their Ability Power as magic damage to all adjacent units. Gain a Vladimir and Lux.
TFT13_Augment_Sorcerer.name: Arcane Retribution

TFT13_Augment_SorcererCrest.desc: Gain a Sorcerer Emblem and a Vladimir.
TFT13_Augment_SorcererCrest.name: Sorcerer Crest

TFT13_Augment_SorcererCrown.desc: Gain a Sorcerer Emblem, an Adaptive Helm, and a Vladimir.
TFT13_Augment_SorcererCrown.name: Sorcerer Crown

TFT13_Augment_TrundleCarry.desc: Gain a Trundle. Your strongest Trundle's Ability no longer heals, but grants him @TOOLTIPONLYAS@% Attack Speed for @TOOLTIPONLYDuration@ seconds, and permanently grants him @TOOLTIPONLYADPerCast@% Attack Damage. His maximum mana is reduced by @ManaReduction@.
TFT13_Augment_TrundleCarry.name: Trolling

TFT13_Augment_Visionary.desc:
For every @Mana@ Mana Visionaries spend during combat, summon a Voidling, up to @MaxVoidlings@ Voidlings. Gain a Rell and Morgana.

The Voidling has @Stage2Health@-@Stage6Health@ Health based on Stage.
TFT13_Augment_Visionary.name: Voidcaller

TFT13_Augment_VisionaryCrest.desc: Gain a Visionary Emblem and a Renata Glasc.
TFT13_Augment_VisionaryCrest.name: Visionary Crest

TFT13_Augment_VisionaryCrown.desc: Gain a Visionary Emblem, a Spear of Shojin, and a Renata Glasc.
TFT13_Augment_VisionaryCrown.name: Visionary Crown

TFT13_Augment_VladCarry.desc: Gain a Vladimir. Your strongest Vladimir gains +@IncRange@ Range and gains @BonusMana@ bonus Mana each attack. His Ability no longer heals but grants @TOOLTIPDamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp, deals @TOOLTIPBonusDamage*100@% bonus damage, and spreads additional damage to the nearest enemy.
TFT13_Augment_VladCarry.name: Crimson Pact

TFT13_Augment_Watcher.desc: Every time Watchers are attacked, they gain @IncreaseADByTakeAttack@% Attack Damage. Every time Watchers are hit by an ability, they gain @IncreaseAPByTakeSpell@ Ability Power. Gain a Vander.
TFT13_Augment_Watcher.name: Battle Scars

TFT13_Augment_WatcherCrest.desc: Gain a Watcher Emblem and a Vander.
TFT13_Augment_WatcherCrest.name: Watcher Crest

TFT13_Augment_WatcherCrown.desc: Gain a Watcher Emblem, a Steadfast Heart, and a Scar.
TFT13_Augment_WatcherCrown.name: Watcher Crown

TFT13_Crime_Bronze_ChemGrips.desc:

TFT15_Augment_Juggernaut_Indomitable.desc: Whenever an ally Juggernaut dies, all other Juggernauts gain a @MaxHealthHeal*100@% max Health shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and gain @AdditionalDurabilityRatio*100@% more Durability. Gain an Aatrox and Dr. Mundo.
TFT15_Augment_Juggernaut_Indomitable.name: Unceasing

TFT15_Augment_KennenCarry.desc: Gain a Kennen. Your strongest Kennen becomes a ranged Marksman. He throws piercing Shurikens that can stun and deal magic damage.
TFT15_Augment_KennenCarry.name: Nine Thousand Volts

TFT15_Augment_Luchador_GrandSlam.desc: Luchadors gain @BonusAS*100@% Attack Speed. When Luchador is active, Luchadors leap into battle at combat start. Luchador leaps deal @PercentBaseAD*100@% of their Basic Attack Damage. Gain a Dr. Mundo.
TFT15_Augment_Luchador_GrandSlam.name: Grand Slam

TFT15_Augment_Luchador_TournamentTitans.desc:
Luchadors gain @BaselineAS*100@% Attack Speed. Whenever you win player combats, Luchadors grow in size and permanently gain @ADPerWin@% Attack Damage and @HealthPerWin@ Health. Gain a Dr Mundo and Gnar.

(Total: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT15_Augment_Luchador_TournamentTitan_AD@% AD; @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT15_Augment_Luchador_TournamentTitan_Health@ Health)
TFT15_Augment_Luchador_TournamentTitans.name: Tournament Titans

TFT15_Augment_MalphiteCarry.desc: Gain a Malphite. Your strongest Malphite becomes a Fighter, gaining increased Attack Speed. He now charges at nearby enemies, knocking them up and dealing heavy damage.
TFT15_Augment_MalphiteCarry.name: Tectonic Titan

TFT15_Augment_Mentor_LearnFromTheBest.desc: Whenever you star-up a champion they permanently gain @BonusPercent*100@% of every unique Mentor bonus of Mentors on your board or bench. Gain a Yasuo.
TFT15_Augment_Mentor_LearnFromTheBest.name: Learn From The Best

TFT15_Augment_Mentor_TeachersCouncil.desc: Mentor bonuses are granted to your team regardless of how many Mentors you play. Gain a Kobuko.
TFT15_Augment_Mentor_TeachersCouncil.name: Teacher's Council

TFT15_Augment_MightyMech_MultiMech.desc:
You no longer gain the Mighty Mech. Instead, all Mighty Mech champions gain @MechStatPercentage*100@% of the Health, Ability Power, and Attack Damage the Mech would have.

Gain an Aatrox.
TFT15_Augment_MightyMech_MultiMech.name: Multi-Mech

TFT15_Augment_MightyMech_PowerUpload.desc:
You can give the Mighty Mech a Power Up. When it has Power Up the Mighty Mech gains @Health@ Health and @DamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp.

Gain an Aatrox, a Senna, and a Power Remover.
TFT15_Augment_MightyMech_PowerUpload.name: Power Upload

TFT15_Augment_NeekoCarry.desc: Gain a Neeko. Your strongest Neeko becomes a Magic Fighter and gains increased Attack Speed. Her Ability deals more damage, and increases its radius with every cast.
TFT15_Augment_NeekoCarry.name: Starfall

TFT15_Augment_ProdigyCirclet.desc: Gain a Prodigy Emblem, a Malzahar, and a Needlessly Large Rod.
TFT15_Augment_ProdigyCirclet.name: Prodigy Circlet

TFT15_Augment_ProdigyCrown.desc: Gain a Prodigy Emblem, a Spear of Shojin, and an Ezreal.
TFT15_Augment_ProdigyCrown.name: Prodigy Crown

TFT15_Augment_Prodigy_UnboundArcana.desc: Every 2 seconds, Prodigies gain Ability Power equal to @PercentManaToAP*100@% of their Mana Regeneration (rounded down).
TFT15_Augment_Prodigy_UnboundArcana.name: Unbound Arcana

TFT15_Augment_ProtectorCirclet.desc: Gain a Protector Emblem, a Neeko, and a Giant's Belt.
TFT15_Augment_ProtectorCirclet.name: Protector Circlet

TFT15_Augment_ProtectorCrown.desc: Gain a Protector Emblem, a Protector's Vow, and a Neeko.
TFT15_Augment_ProtectorCrown.name: Protector Crown

TFT15_Augment_Protector_PreemptiveProtec.desc: Combat start: Protectors shield themselves and their closest ally for @ShieldPercentAmount*100@% of their maximum health. Shields stack. Gain a Rakan.
TFT15_Augment_Protector_PreemptiveProtec.name: Preemptive Protection

TFT15_Augment_RingKingCirclet.desc: Gain a Luchador Emblem and a Dr Mundo.
TFT15_Augment_RingKingCirclet.name: Luchador Circlet

TFT15_Augment_RingKingCrown.desc: Gain a Luchador Emblem, a Sterak's Gage, and a Dr Mundo.
TFT15_Augment_RingKingCrown.name: Luchador Crown

TFT15_Augment_SentaiCirclet.desc: Gain a Mighty Mech Crest and a Lucian
TFT15_Augment_SentaiCirclet.name: Mighty Mech Circlet

TFT15_Augment_SentaiCrown.desc: Gain a Mighty Mech Emblem, a Kraken's Fury, and a Lucian.
TFT15_Augment_SentaiCrown.name: Mighty Mech Crown

TFT15_Augment_SentaiRanger_BeTheArms.desc:
The Mighty Mech gains @BonusAS*100@% Attack Speed.

Field 7 Mighty Mech, reach level 10, and hold all 3 Mighty Mech Augments to activate MECHA-MERGE PROTOCOL.
TFT15_Augment_SentaiRanger_BeTheArms.name: I'll Be The Arms

TFT15_Augment_SentaiRanger_BeTheHead.desc:
The Mighty Mech gains @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed. Gain a 3 Mighty Mech Champions.

Field 7 Mighty Mech with a total of @TOOLTIPStarLevelReq@ Star Levels and reach level 10 to activate MECHA-MERGE PROTOCOL.
TFT15_Augment_SentaiRanger_BeTheHead.name: I'll Be The Head

TFT15_Augment_SentaiRanger_BeTheHead_Gol.desc:
The Mighty Mech gains @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed. Gain a Gangplank.

Field 7 Mighty Mech with a total of @TOOLTIPStarLevelReq@ Star Levels and reach level 10 to activate MECHA-MERGE PROTOCOL.
TFT15_Augment_SentaiRanger_BeTheHead_Gol.name: I'll Be The Head

TFT15_Augment_SentaiRanger_BeTheLegs.desc:
The Mighty Mech gains @BonusDefenses@ Armor and Magic Resist and @BonusHealth@ Health. Gain 3 Mighty Mech champions.

Field 7 Mighty Mech, reach level 10, and hold all 3 Mighty Mech Augments to activate MECHA-MERGE PROTOCOL.
TFT15_Augment_SentaiRanger_BeTheLegs.name: I'll Be The Legs

TFT15_Augment_ShenCarry.desc: Gain a Shen. Your strongest Shen becomes a ranged Marksman gaining +3 Range. His ability no longer shields but instead deals additional damage.
TFT15_Augment_ShenCarry.name: Twilight Assault

TFT15_Augment_SniperCirclet.desc: Gain a Sniper Emblem, a Jinx, and a Recurve Bow.
TFT15_Augment_SniperCirclet.name: Sniper Circlet

TFT15_Augment_SniperCrown.desc: Gain a Sniper Emblem, an Infinity Edge, and a Caitlyn.
TFT15_Augment_SniperCrown.name: Sniper Crown

TFT15_Augment_Sniper_PreciseShot.desc: Every @Cadence@ seconds, all Sniper champions fire a shot that deals @BaseADPercent*100@% of their Basic Attack Damage to the lowest health enemy in range. Gain a Jhin.
TFT15_Augment_Sniper_PreciseShot.name: Precise Shot

TFT15_Augment_Sorcerer_DazzlingDisplay.desc: Enemies who take damage from Sorcerer Abilities deal @DamageReduction*100%@% less damage for @Duration@ seconds. Gain a Lux and a Lucian.
TFT15_Augment_Sorcerer_DazzlingDisplay.name: Dazzling Display

TFT15_Augment_SoulFighterCirclet.desc: Gain a Soul Fighter Emblem and a Kalista.
TFT15_Augment_SoulFighterCirclet.name: Soul Fighter Circlet

TFT15_Augment_SoulFighterCrown.desc: Gain a Soul Fighter Emblem, a Spear of Shojin, and a Kalista.
TFT15_Augment_SoulFighterCrown.name: Soul Fighter Crown

TFT15_Augment_SoulFighter_SoulSurge.desc: When they hit Max Power, Soul Fighters gain @AS*100@% Attack Speed and @Durability*100@% Durability for @Duration@ seconds.
TFT15_Augment_SoulFighter_SoulSurge.name: Soul Surge

TFT15_Augment_SoulFighter_TheGodsEyeOpen.desc: Every @Cadence@ seconds the God's Eye grants a random Soul Fighter @ShieldAmount@ shield and @AS*100@% stacking Attack Speed for the rest of combat. Gain a Kalista and Naafiri.
TFT15_Augment_SoulFighter_TheGodsEyeOpen.name: The God's Eye Opens

TFT15_Augment_SoulFighter_TournamentFavo.desc:
Soul Fighters gain Fame when they deal damage. Each Fame breakpoint grants loot. Gain a Naafiri and Kalista.

Fame: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT15_Augment_SoulFighter_TournamentFavorites_Damage@/@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT15_Augment_SoulFighter_TournamentFavorites_Breakpoint@
TFT15_Augment_SoulFighter_TournamentFavo.name: Tournament Favorites

TFT15_Augment_SpellslingerCirclet.desc: Gain an Sorcerer Emblem, a Karma, and a Tear of the Goddess.
TFT15_Augment_SpellslingerCirclet.name: Sorcerer Circlet

TFT15_Augment_SpellslingerCrown.desc: Gain a Sorcerer Emblem, a Jeweled Gauntlet, and an Ahri.
TFT15_Augment_SpellslingerCrown.name: Sorcerer Crown

TFT15_Augment_StarGuardianCirclet.desc: Gain a Star Guardian Emblem and a Rell.
TFT15_Augment_StarGuardianCirclet.name: Star Guardian Circlet

TFT15_Augment_StarGuardianCrown.desc: Gain a Star Guardian Emblem, a Steadfast Heart, and a Rell.
TFT15_Augment_StarGuardianCrown.name: Star Guardian Crown

TFT15_Augment_StarGuardian_PowerOfFriend.desc: Star Guardians who start combat adjacent to at least one other Star Guardian gain @Mana@ Mana Regeneration, @Defenses@ Armor, and @Defenses@ Magic Resist. Gain a Rell.
TFT15_Augment_StarGuardian_PowerOfFriend.name: Power of Friendship

TFT15_Augment_StarGuardian_Superstar.desc: Star Guardians with a Power Up grant @PercentIncrease*100@% increased Star Guardian bonuses. Gain a Xayah.
TFT15_Augment_StarGuardian_Superstar.name: Star Power

TFT15_Augment_StarGuardian_TinyTeam.desc: When you field @MaxStarGuardians@ or less Star Guardians, increase Star Guardian bonuses by an additional @BonusIncrease*100@%. Gain a Syndra and Rell.
TFT15_Augment_StarGuardian_TinyTeam.name: Tiny Team

TFT15_Augment_StrategistCirclet.desc: Gain a Strategist Emblem, a Ziggs, and a Tear of the Goddess.
TFT15_Augment_StrategistCirclet.name: Strategist Circlet

TFT15_Augment_StrategistCrown.desc: Gain a Strategist Emblem, a Janna, and an Adaptive Helm.
TFT15_Augment_StrategistCrown.name: Strategist Crown

TFT15_Augment_Strategist_GamePlan.desc: Mark 1 hex per Strategist fielded. Allies standing in marked hexes gain @FlatHealth@ Health and @BonusDamage*100@% Damage Amp, Strategists gain @PercentIncrease*100@% more. Gain a Janna and Ziggs.
TFT15_Augment_Strategist_GamePlan.name: Game Plan

TFT15_Augment_SupremeCellsCirclet.desc: Gain a Supreme Cells Emblem and an Akali.
TFT15_Augment_SupremeCellsCirclet.name: Supreme Cells Circlet

TFT15_Augment_SupremeCellsCrown.desc: Gain a Supreme Cells Emblem, a Last Whisper, and a Kai'sa.
TFT15_Augment_SupremeCellsCrown.name: Supreme Cells Crown

TFT15_Augment_SupremeCells_AllForOne.desc: Whenever an ally dies, they grant the Supreme Cell with the most damage this round @PercentHealth*100@% of their maximum health. Gain a Kai'Sa and Kennen.
TFT15_Augment_SupremeCells_AllForOne.name: The Strongest Survive

TFT15_Augment_SupremeCells_NewContenders.desc: Grant @BonusSharePercent*100@% of Supreme Cell's bonus to all champions on your team. Any champion on your team can now become the Supreme Cell. Gain a Kai'Sa and Kennen.
TFT15_Augment_SupremeCells_NewContenders.name: New Contenders

TFT15_Augment_TheCrew_EscapeVelocity.desc:
Gain 1 Velocity per reroll, and @LevelNum@ when you level up. Crew units gain @AS*100%@% Attack Speed for every 3 Velocity.

(Velocity: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT15_Augment_TheCrew_EscapeVelocity_Velocity@)
TFT15_Augment_TheCrew_EscapeVelocity.name: Escape Velocity

TFT15_Augment_TheCrew_SpaceCamp.desc: Whenever you upgrade a 1-cost Crew champion, gain a random 1-3 cost Crew champion. Gain a Malphite.
TFT15_Augment_TheCrew_SpaceCamp.name: Space Camp

TFT15_Augment_UdyrCarry.desc: Gain an Udyr. Your strongest Udyr becomes an Attack Fighter and sends bouncing gusts of flame out with every attack. His spell no longer rapidly attacks, but instead grants him stacking Attack Speed.
TFT15_Augment_UdyrCarry.name: Burning Bright

TFT15_Augment_ViCarry.desc: Gain a Vi. Your strongest Vi becomes an Attack Fighter and has a chance to drop loot on kill. She now deals heavy single target damage and gains Attack Damage for item components equipped on your team.
TFT15_Augment_ViCarry.name: Knuckledusters

TFT15_Augment_Wraith_DeepeningShadows.desc: At combat start and whenever the Shadow Realm strikes, Wraith champions gain @AD*100@% Attack Damage and @AP@% Ability Power. Gain a Jhin and Zac.
TFT15_Augment_Wraith_DeepeningShadows.name: Deepening Shadows

TFT15_Augment_Wraith_ShadowHomunculous.desc: The first @NumWraiths@ Wraith champions to die each combat summon a monstrosity from the Shadow Realm. Gain a Jhin and Zac.
TFT15_Augment_Wraith_ShadowHomunculous.name: The Darkness Within

TFT15_Augment_ZacCarry.desc: Gain a Zac. Your strongest Zac becomes a Specialist. He now bounces around the battlefield dealing damage in a one hex radius.
TFT15_Augment_ZacCarry.name: Perfect Form

TFT15_CrystalRose_Pass.desc: Increase Gem Power gains for the next 3 player combats. If you win, lose a large amount of your Gem Power<showIfNot.TFT15_CrystalGambit_HasDiamondHands> and immediately cash out</showIfNot.TFT15_CrystalGambit_HasDiamondHands>.
TFT15_CrystalRose_Pass.name: Double Down

TFT15_CrystalRose_Pass_PVE.desc: Increase Gem Power gains for the next 3 player combats. If you lose, lose a large amount of your Gem Power<showIfNot.TFT15_CrystalGambit_HasDiamondHands> and immediately cash out</showIfNot.TFT15_CrystalGambit_HasDiamondHands>.
TFT15_CrystalRose_Pass_PVE.name: Double Down

TFT15_CrystalRose_Pass_PVE_Item.desc: Increase Gem Power gains for the next 3 player combats. If you lose, lose a large amount of your Gem Power<showIfNot.TFT15_CrystalGambit_HasDiamondHands> and immediately cash out</showIfNot.TFT15_CrystalGambit_HasDiamondHands>.
TFT15_CrystalRose_Pass_PVE_Item.name: Double Down

TFT15_HiddenTech_AffinityForCold.desc:
Combat Start: Chill all enemies in the back 2 rows

Chill: Reduce healing received by 20%
TFT15_HiddenTech_AffinityForCold.name: Cold Affinity

TFT15_HiddenTech_ArcaneRend.desc:
Allies that start combat in the back @NumRow@ rows @MRReduction*100@% Shred enemies for @Duration@ seconds when dealing magic damage.

Shred: Reduce Magic Resist
TFT15_HiddenTech_ArcaneRend.name: Arcane Rend

TFT15_HiddenTech_DormantProphecy.desc: Combat Start: If the holder is 3 star, they star up.
TFT15_HiddenTech_DormantProphecy.name: Dormant Prophecy

TFT15_HiddenTech_FireStorm.desc:
Combat Start: Wound all enemies for @Duration@ seconds.

Wound: Reduce healing received by 50%
TFT15_HiddenTech_FireStorm.name: Fire Storm

TFT15_HiddenTech_FlameAffinity.desc:
Wounded allies gain @WoundDamageAmp*100@% %i:scaleDA%.

Wound: Reduce healing received by 50%
TFT15_HiddenTech_FlameAffinity.name: Flame Affinity

TFT15_HiddenTech_FusionHex.desc: <spellPassive>Combat Start:</spellPassive> Merge with the nearest ally gaining @StatPercent*100@% of their Health, Attack Damage, Ability Power.
TFT15_HiddenTech_FusionHex.name: Fusion Hex

TFT15_HiddenTech_KiBarrier.desc: The holder takes @FlatReducedDamage@ less damage from all sources.
TFT15_HiddenTech_KiBarrier.name: Ki Barrier

TFT15_HiddenTech_LimitBreak.desc: Gain @AbilityPower@ Ability Power & @AttackDamage@% Attack Damage. Triple it when below @HealthThreshold@% Health.
TFT15_HiddenTech_LimitBreak.name: Limit Break

TFT15_HiddenTech_ShatterSweep.desc:
Allies that start combat in the back @NumRow@ rows @ArmorReduction*100@% Sunder enemies for @Duration@ seconds when dealing physical damage.

Sunder: Reduce Armor
TFT15_HiddenTech_ShatterSweep.name: Shatter Sweep

TFT15_HiddenTech_ShieldMelt.desc: Combat Start: Your team deals @BonusDamage@% bonus damage to shielded enemies.
TFT15_HiddenTech_ShieldMelt.name: Shield Melt

TFT15_HiddenTech_Test1.desc: Use your Power Snax on a champion to unlock Power Ups.
TFT15_HiddenTech_Test1.name: Use your Power Snax on a champion to unlock Power Ups.

TFT15_HiddenTech_TrainingWeights.desc:
This champion receives a penalty for @NumRounds@ rounds losing -@DamagePenalty*100@% %i:scaleDA% and -@DurabilityPenalty*100@% %i:scaleDR% and capping their Attack Speed to @ASCapPenality@.

After @NumRounds@ rounds, remove the penalty and instead gain @ASReward*100@% %i:scaleAS% and @DamageReward*100@% %i:scaleDA%.

Rounds are tracked per Champion.
TFT15_HiddenTech_TrainingWeights.name: Training Weights

TFT15_HiddenTech_UnyieldingCovenant.desc: This champion is <TFTKeyword>Untargetable</TFTKeyword> while at least @NumAlliesAlive@ allies are alive (does not include the holder).
TFT15_HiddenTech_UnyieldingCovenant.name: Unyielding Covenant

TFT15_Item_BastionEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the Bastion trait.
Gain @ResistConversionToADRatio*100@% of Armor as Attack Damage.
Gain @ResistConversionToAPRatio*100@% of Magic Resistance as Ability Power.
TFT15_Item_BastionEmblemItem.name: Bastion Emblem

TFT15_Item_BattleAcademiaEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Battle Academia trait, and @HealthPerPotential@ Health and @DAPerPotential*100@% Damage Amp per %i:set14AmpIcon%.
TFT15_Item_BattleAcademiaEmblemItem.name: Battle Academia Emblem

TFT15_Item_ChallengerEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the Duelist trait.

Attacks deal @BaseTrueDamage@ bonus true damage, plus @BonusTrueDamage@ bonus true damage for each time the target was damaged by this effect.
TFT15_Item_ChallengerEmblemItem.name: Duelist Emblem

TFT15_Item_CrystalRoseEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Crystal Gambit trait.
TFT15_Item_CrystalRoseEmblemItem.name: Crystal Gambit Emblem

TFT15_Item_CrystalRoseHellionItem.desc: Your team gains @Health@ health. Whenever a unit dies, a crystalline copy one star level lower joins the fight!
TFT15_Item_CrystalRoseHellionItem.name: Crystalline Reinforcements

TFT15_Item_DestroyerEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the Executioner trait.
Attacks and Abilities that critically strike deal @BleedDamage*100@% bonus true damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds.
TFT15_Item_DestroyerEmblemItem.name: Executioner Emblem

TFT15_Item_DragonFistFighterStance.desc:
Passive: On attack, deal @ModifiedPassiveCloneDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to a nearby enemy.

Active: Strike swiftly, sending @ModifiedNumClones@ (%i:scaleAS%) afterimages to the nearest @NumEnemies@ enemies. Each deals @ModifiedCloneDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage and reduces armor by @ModifiedArmorShred@ (%i:scaleAP%).
TFT15_Item_DragonFistFighterStance.name: Duelist Stance

TFT15_Item_DragonFistReaperStance.desc:
Deal @ModifiedStrikeDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to the lowest Health enemy within @HexRange@ hexes and Stun them for @StunDuration@ seconds. Other enemies in a 1-hex radius take @ModifiedAOEDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.

After @NumKills@ kills with this ability all enemies instantly take @ModifiedShockwaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage and are Stunned for @KillStunDuration@ seconds.
TFT15_Item_DragonFistReaperStance.name: Executioner Stance

TFT15_Item_DragonFistTankStance.desc: Briefly gain <scaleLevel>@WindowedDR*100@%</scaleLevel> Durability, then deal <physicalDamage>@ModifiedInitialDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to the target,  <physicalDamage>@ModifiedFinalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to all enemies behind the target, and <physicalDamage>@ModifiedAllEnemiesDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to other enemies in a 2-hex radius.
TFT15_Item_DragonFistTankStance.name: Juggernaut Stance

TFT15_Item_EdgelordEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the Edgelord trait.
Dealing physical damage to an enemy reduces their Armor by @ArmorPerDamage@.
TFT15_Item_EdgelordEmblemItem.name: Edgelord Emblem

TFT15_Item_EmpyreanEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Wraith trait.
TFT15_Item_EmpyreanEmblemItem.name: Wraith Emblem

TFT15_Item_HeavyweightEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Heavyweight trait, and gains @HealthPerTakedown@ max Health on takedown.
TFT15_Item_HeavyweightEmblemItem.name: Heavyweight Emblem

TFT15_Item_JuggernautEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the Juggernaut trait.
While above @HealthBreakpoint*100@% Health, gain @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.
TFT15_Item_JuggernautEmblemItem.name: Juggernaut Emblem

TFT15_Item_ProdigyEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the Prodigy trait.
On cast, shield the lowest percent Health ally for @ManaConversion*100@% of mana spent.
TFT15_Item_ProdigyEmblemItem.name: Prodigy Emblem

TFT15_Item_ProtectorEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the Protector trait.
When a shield on the holder breaks, heal the holder and the nearest ally for @HealPercent@% of the shield's initial value.
TFT15_Item_ProtectorEmblemItem.name: Protector Emblem

TFT15_Item_RingKingsEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Luchador trait.
TFT15_Item_RingKingsEmblemItem.name: Luchador Emblem

TFT15_Item_ShotcallerEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the Strategist trait.

Combat Start: The holder and allies within @NumHexes@ hex in the same row gain bonuses.
Front 2 rows: @ResistBuff@ Armor and Magic Resist
Back 2 rows: @ASBuff*100@% Attack Speed
TFT15_Item_ShotcallerEmblemItem.name: Strategist Emblem

TFT15_Item_SniperEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Sniper trait and @Range@ range.
TFT15_Item_SniperEmblemItem.name: Sniper Emblem

TFT15_Item_SoulFighterEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Soul Fighter trait.
TFT15_Item_SoulFighterEmblemItem.name: Soul Fighter Emblem

TFT15_Item_SpellslingerEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the Sorcerer trait.
The holder gains @APIncrease*100@% more Ability Power from all sources.
TFT15_Item_SpellslingerEmblemItem.name: Sorcerer Emblem

TFT15_Item_StarGuardianEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the Star Guardian trait.

Teamwork: Non-emblem Star Guardian bonuses are increased by @Percent@%. This effect stacks.

[Unique - only 1 per champion.]
TFT15_Item_StarGuardianEmblemItem.name: Star Guardian Emblem

TFT15_Item_SupremeCellsEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Supreme Cells trait.
TFT15_Item_SupremeCellsEmblemItem.name: Supreme Cells Emblem

TFT15_MechanicTrait_BloodFury_Consumable.desc: Consume @HealthToFeed@ player health for Health %i:scaleHealth%, Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% and Ability Power %i:scaleAP%.
TFT15_MechanicTrait_BloodFury_Consumable.name: A Hungry Snack

TFT15_MechanicTrait_ExpungePowerItem.desc: Use on a champion to remove their Power Up and regain a Power Snax.
TFT15_MechanicTrait_ExpungePowerItem.name: Power Remover

TFT15_RoboRanger_Core.desc:
Mighty Mech champions heal The Mighty Mech for @TFTUnitProperty.Item:TFT15_SentaiRanger_GalioHealRatio@% of the damage they deal.

By our powers combined!
TFT15_RoboRanger_Core.name: Combination Core

TFT15_RoboRanger_Slicer.desc:
Deal an additional @PercentTrueDamage*100@% of all damage dealt as true damage.

Bring down the blade of justice!
TFT15_RoboRanger_Slicer.name: Mega Blade Upgrade

TFT15_RoboRanger_Sword.desc:
Attacks now cleave in a cone dealing @ADPercent*100@% physical damage to adjacent enemies.

We slice through evil with unbreakable resolve.
TFT15_RoboRanger_Sword.name: Mighty Blade

TFT15_SetMechanic_Consumable.desc: <spellPassive>Power Up:</spellPassive> Use on a champion to choose a Power Up! Sell that champion or use a Power Remover to regain a Power Snax.
TFT15_SetMechanic_Consumable.name: Power Snax

TFT15_SetMechanic_Consumable_2.desc: <spellPassive>Power Up:</spellPassive> Use on a champion to choose a Power Up! Sell that champion or use a Power Remover to regain a Power Snax.
TFT15_SetMechanic_Consumable_2.name: Unlock Power (2 uses left)

TFT15_SetMechanic_Remover.desc: Use on a champion to remove their Power Up and regain a Power Snax.
TFT15_SetMechanic_Remover.name: Power Remover

TFT15_SetMechanic_Remover_10.desc: Use on a champion to remove their Power Up and regain a Power Snax.
TFT15_SetMechanic_Remover_10.name: Power Remover (9 uses left)

TFT15_SetMechanic_Remover_2.desc: Use on a champion to remove their Power Up and regain a Power Snax.

Use on any champion to gain an emblem for each of their listed traits.

[Consumable - This item disappears when used.]
TFT16_Item_WorldRune.name: Realm Warp

TFT16_Item_YordleEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Yordle trait.
TFT16_Item_YordleEmblemItem.name: Yordle Emblem

TFT16_Item_ZaunEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Zaun trait.
TFT16_Item_ZaunEmblemItem.name: Zaun Emblem

TFT16_TeamupAugment_AmbessaKindred.desc: Gain an Ambessa and a Kindred. When Kindred casts, Ambessa always gains their protection against death and gains Attack Damage while protected. When Ambessa casts, Wolf strikes all enemies hit, dealing reduced damage.
TFT16_TeamupAugment_AmbessaKindred.name: Chosen Wolves

TFT16_TeamupAugment_EkkoZilean.desc:
Gain 2 Ekkos. Gain @XP@XP every combat Ekko participates in. Gain an Ekko every time you level up. At 3-Star, gain a Zilean.

Ekko's empowered attacks echo to all enemies being damaged by Zilean's spell, dealing @DamageShare*100@% of the original damage.
TFT16_TeamupAugment_EkkoZilean.name: Timewinders

TFT16_TeamupAugment_JarvanShyvana.desc: Gain a Shyvana and a 2-star Jarvan IV. When Jarvan casts, Shyvana gains Shield. When Shyvana casts, Jarvan jumps in and deals damage based on his Armor and Magic Resist. After every player combat, gain a Jarvan IV.
TFT16_TeamupAugment_JarvanShyvana.name: Dragonguards

TFT16_TeamupAugment_LucianVayne.desc: Gain a Lucian & Senna and a 2-star Vayne. Vayne fires additional bolts at enemies afflicted with Black Mist and on takedown, grants Attack Speed to Lucian & Senna.
TFT16_TeamupAugment_LucianVayne.name: Sentinels of Light

TFT16_TeamupAugment_SeraphineSona.desc: Gain a Seraphine. Seraphine's heal is increased based on her ally's missing Health. Sona gains the Disruptor trait and fires an additional bolt with every cast. Gain a Sona after each player combat.
TFT16_TeamupAugment_SeraphineSona.name: Joint Album

TFT16_TeamupAugment_SingedTeemo.desc: Gain a 2-star Teemo. Singed's damage refreshes Teemo's poisons, and every @TeemoDamageReq@ magic damage Teemo deals grants your strongest Singed @SingedAPGain@% Ability Power. Gain a Teemo after each player combat.
TFT16_TeamupAugment_SingedTeemo.name: Poison Pals

TFT16_TeamupAugment_SpinToWin.desc: Gain a Yasuo and Rek'Sai. Each time your spinning champions spend @ManaToSpend@ total Mana they permanently gain @Health@ Health and @DamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp. Fielding more increases their spin area by 1-hex.
TFT16_TeamupAugment_SpinToWin.name: Spin to Win

TFT16_TheDarkinAegis.desc:
The holder gains the Darkin trait.

Every second, deal @PercentHealthDamage@% of the holder's max Health as magic damage to enemies within @HexRadius@ hexes. When units die in the area, heal for @HealPercent*100@% max Health.
TFT16_TheDarkinAegis.name: The Darkin Aegis

TFT16_TheDarkinBow.desc:
The holder gains the Darkin trait.

Every @NumAttacks@ attacks, fire an arrow that passes through the current target, dealing @ArrowBaseADDamage*100@% Basic Attack Damage as physical damage, reduced by @ArrowPercentFalloff*100@% per enemy hit.
TFT16_TheDarkinBow.name: The Darkin Bow

TFT16_TheDarkinScythe.desc:
The holder gains the Darkin trait.

Every @TickRate@ seconds, slash adjacent enemies for @SlashADPercent*100@% Basic Attack Damage as physical damage. On takedown or when the holder dashes, slash again.

Dash Cooldown: @DashCooldown@ second
TFT16_TheDarkinScythe.name: The Darkin Scythe

TFT16_TheDarkinStaff.desc:
The holder gains the Darkin trait.

For every @ManaSpent@ Mana spent, launch a tendril at enemies near the current target, dealing @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT_Item_Artifact_DarkinStaff_Damage@ magic damage.

Damage increases based on Stage
TFT16_TheDarkinStaff.name: The Darkin Staff

TFT16_Void_TransmutableRelic.desc: When equipped, this item transforms into the optimal item for the champion.
TFT16_Void_TransmutableRelic.name: Trasmutable Relic

TFT16_XerathZap_AscendedsCall.desc: Next combat: Shurimans gain @AD*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% per second. After @ASDelay@ seconds, gain @AttackSpeed*100@% %i:scaleAS%.
TFT16_XerathZap_AscendedsCall.name: Ascended's Call

TFT16_XerathZap_CrumblingSands.desc: Next combat: Stun all enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds.
TFT16_XerathZap_CrumblingSands.name: Crumbling Sands

TFT16_XerathZap_EmperorsProsperity.desc: Next combat: Shurimans gain @DamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp and crowd control immunity.
TFT16_XerathZap_EmperorsProsperity.name: Rite Of Negation

TFT16_XerathZap_FatefulFind.desc: Roll @DiceAmount@ dice. Gain gold equal to the sum.
TFT16_XerathZap_FatefulFind.name: Fateful Find

TFT16_XerathZap_Judgement.desc: Next combat: If you win, gain @GoldOnWin@ gold; if you lose, gain @XPOnLose@ XP.
TFT16_XerathZap_Judgement.name: Judgment

TFT16_XerathZap_OasissReprieve.desc: Next combat: After @Delay@ seconds, your team rapidly recovers @PercentHeal*100@% maximum Health.
TFT16_XerathZap_OasissReprieve.name: Oasis's Reprieve

TFT16_XerathZap_PersistentArcanery.desc: Next combat: Xerath gains @ManaRegen@ Mana Regen and his spell fires @ExtraBlasts@ extra blasts.
TFT16_XerathZap_PersistentArcanery.name: Persistent Arcanery

TFT16_XerathZap_RiteOfNegation.desc: Next combat: Shurimans gain @DamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp and crowd control immunity.
TFT16_XerathZap_RiteOfNegation.name: Rite Of Negation

TFT16_XerathZap_SacrificialGuard.desc: Next combat: Azir's Guards explode on death, dealing @ExplosionDamage@ magic damage in a 2 hex area.
TFT16_XerathZap_SacrificialGuard.name: Sacrificial Guard

TFT16_XerathZap_ScaleOfJudgement.desc: Next combat: If you win, gain @GoldOnWin@ gold; if you lose, gain @HPOnLose@ player health.
TFT16_XerathZap_ScaleOfJudgement.name: Scale Of Judgment

TFT16_XerathZap_TheChariot.desc: This round, rerolls cost you @RerollCost@ gold and buying XP costs you @XPCost@ gold.
TFT16_XerathZap_TheChariot.name: The Chariot

TFT16_XerathZap_TheEmperor.desc: Next combat: Xerath gains @XerathDamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp. All other allies gain @TeamDamageAmp*100@%.
TFT16_XerathZap_TheEmperor.name: The Emperor

TFT16_XerathZap_TheLovers.desc: Gain a 5-cost champion and a 2* 2-cost champion that share traits.
TFT16_XerathZap_TheLovers.name: The Lovers

TFT16_XerathZap_TheWorld.desc: Gain a copy of every unlocked 4-cost champion.
TFT16_XerathZap_TheWorld.name: Faithful Followers

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier0_ClunkyPrototy.desc: Combat start: Gain a @Shield*100@% max Health shield.
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier0_ClunkyPrototy.name: Broken Prototype

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier0_LeakyPrototyp.desc: Every @Interval@ seconds, this item loses @APLoss@ Ability Power and gains @ManaRegenPerLoss@ Mana Regen.
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier0_LeakyPrototyp.name: Leaky Prototype

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier0_SparkingProto.desc: Every @Interval@ seconds, gain @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed for @Duration@ seconds.
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier0_SparkingProto.name: Sparking Prototype

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier1_GuidingHex.desc:
Every @Frequency@ seconds, fire a bolt at a random enemy in Attack Range, dealing @ProjectileDamage@ magic damage.

Aurora Bonus: If this item is equipped on Aurora, she gains @AuroraAPOnHit@ Ability Power when the bolt hits.

Damage increases based on Stage.
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier1_GuidingHex.name: Guiding Hex

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier1_RocketSwarm.desc:
Every @ManaThreshold@ Mana spent, fire a barrage of @NumRockets@ rockets at the target, each dealing @RocketDamagePercent*100@% %i:TFTBaseAD% physical damage.

Jinx Bonus: If this item is equipped on Jinx, instead replace all ability bullets with rockets that deal @JinxPercentIncrease*100@% increased damage.
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier1_RocketSwarm.name: Rocket Swarm

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier1_SavageSlicer.desc:
Attacks hit the target and all adjacent enemies for @SplashDamage*100@% of Basic Attack Damage. Omnivamp applies @OmnivampEffectiveness*100@% to this damage.

Briar Bonus: If this item is equipped on Briar, on cast this effect happens @BriarHitsOnCast@ times.
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier1_SavageSlicer.name: Savage Slicer

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier1_TentacleSlam.desc:
Every @Frequency@ seconds, summon a tentacle that slams down on the target, dealing @SlamDamage@ physical damage and healing the holder for @Heal*100@% max health.

Illaoi Bonus: If this item is equipped on Illaoi, an additional tentacle slams targets drained by her ability at @IllaoiEffectiveness*100@% effectiveness.

Damage increases based on Stage.
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier1_TentacleSlam.name: Tentacle Slam

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_Annihilator.desc:
Store @DamageStore*100@% of damage dealt. On death or after @Delay@ seconds in combat, deal the stored damage as true damage to all enemies, reduced by @HexFalloff*100@% for each hex they are away from the epicenter.

Recommended Roles: Attack or Magic Caster
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_Annihilator.name: The Annihilator

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_BattleBunnyCr.desc:
Gain Precision.

Every @NumCritsNeeded@ critical strikes, fire @NumArrows@ piercing arrows that can critically strike towards the target. Each deals @ArrowDamagePercent*100@% %i:TFTBaseAD% physical damage.

{{TFT_Keyword_Precision}}
Max @MaxPerSpell@ stacks per Ability cast.
Recommended Roles: Attack Marksman or Fighter
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_BattleBunnyCr.name: Battle Bunny Crossbow

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_CyclonicSlice.desc:
Gain 3 orbiting razors. Razors deal @Damage@ magic damage, and 30% Shred and Sunder enemies for @ShredDuration@ seconds. Deal @DamageIncrease*100@% increased damage to Shredded or Sundered enemies.

Damage increases based on Stage.
Recommended Roles: Attack or Magic Fighter
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_CyclonicSlice.name: Cyclonic Slicers

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_EchoingBatbla.desc:
Every @NumAttacks@ attacks, fire @NumArrows@ batblades split between the 3 nearest enemies. Each blade deals @ArrowDamagePercent*100@% %i:TFTBaseAD% physical damage.

Recommended Role: Attack Marksman
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_EchoingBatbla.name: Echoing Batblades

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_IceblastArmor.desc:
The first time you fall below @HealthThreshold1*100@% and @HealthThreshold2*100@% health, gain a @ShieldPercent*100@% max health shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and release a frost nova that stuns enemies within @HexRange@ hexes for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Recommended Roles: Attack or Magic Tank
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_IceblastArmor.name: Iceblast Armor

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_LionessLament.desc:
Every @HealthPerMissile*100@% max health lost, fire crescent projectiles in a line dealing physical damage equal to @ResistPercent*100@% of the holder's Armor and Magic Resist. Steal @ResistSteal@ Armor and Magic Resist from all enemies hit.

Recommended Roles: Attack or Magic Tank
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_LionessLament.name: Lioness's Lament

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_RadiantField.desc:
Gain @HealthPercent*100@% max health. Every second, deal magic damage in a @HexRadiusBase@-hex radius equal to @HealthRatio*100@% of the holder's max Health. Radius increases every @Period@ seconds.

Recommended Roles: Attack or Magic Tank
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_RadiantField.name: Radiant Field

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_SearingShortb.desc:
For every @ManaPerProjectile@ mana spent, fire a projectile at a nearby enemy, dealing @ProjectileDamage@ + @APScalar*100@% of the holder's Ability Power magic damage and applying @BurnPercent@% Burn and @GrievousWoundsPercent@% Wound to enemies for @BurnDuration@ seconds.

Damage increases based on Stage.
Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second
Wound: Reduces healing received
Recommended Role: Magic Caster
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_SearingShortb.name: Searing Shortbow

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_UwuBlaster.desc:
Every attack, fire @NumUwUBlasts@ laser blasts random targets in range, dealing @ADDamage*100@% of the holder's Attack Damage as physical damage.

Recommended Role: Attack Marksman
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier2_UwuBlaster.name: UwU Blaster

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_Annihilator.desc:
Store @DamageStore*100@% of damage dealt. Every @Delay@ seconds and on death, deal the stored damage as true damage to all enemies, reduced by @HexFalloff*100@% for each hex they are from the epicenter.

Recommended Roles: Attack or Magic Caster
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_Annihilator.name: Animapocalypse

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_BattleBunnyCr.desc:
Gain Precision.

Every @NumCritsNeeded@ critical strikes, fire @NumArrows@ piercing arrows that can critically strike towards the target. Each deals @ArrowDamagePercent*100@% %i:TFTBaseAD% physical damage.

On takedown, fire a burst of @ArrowsOnTakedown@ arrows from the target.

{{TFT_Keyword_Precision}}
Max @MaxPerSpell@ stacks per Ability cast.
Recommended Roles: Attack Marksman or Fighter
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_BattleBunnyCr.name: Bunny Prime Ballista

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_CyclonicSlice.desc:
Gain 6 orbiting razors. Razors deal @Damage@ true damage, and 30% Shred and Sunder enemies for the rest of combat. Deal @DamageIncrease*100@% increased damage to Shredded or Sundered enemies.

Damage increases based on Stage.
Recommended Roles: Attack or Magic Fighter
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_CyclonicSlice.name: Unceasing Cyclone

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_EchoingBatbla.desc:
Every @NumAttacks@ attacks, fire @NumArrows@ chromablades split between all enemies. Each blade deals @ArrowDamagePercent*100@% %i:TFTBaseAD% physical damage.

Recommended Role: Attack Marksman
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_EchoingBatbla.name: Vayne's Chromablades

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_IceblastArmor.desc:
The first time you fall below @HealthThreshold1*100@%, @HealthThreshold2*100@%, @HealthThreshold3*100@%, and @HealthThreshold4*100@% health, gain a @ShieldPercent*100@% max health shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. When this happens, release a frost nova that stuns enemies within @HexRange@ hexes for @StunDuration@ seconds and deals magic damage equal to @MaxHealthDamage*100@% of their max Health.

The radius increases by @HexRangeIncreasePerProc@ each nova.

Recommended Roles: Attack or Magic Tank
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_IceblastArmor.name: Deep Freeze

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_LionessLament.desc:
Every @HealthPerMissile*100@% max health lost, fire crescent projectiles in @PrismaticNumTargets@ lines dealing physical damage equal to @ResistPercent*100@% of the holder's Armor and Magic Resist. Steal @ResistSteal@ Armor and Magic Resist from all enemies hit.

Recommended Roles: Attack or Magic Tank
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_LionessLament.name: Leonine Lamentation

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_RadiantField.desc:
Gain @HealthPercent*100@% max Health. Every second, deal magic damage in a @HexRadiusBase@ hex radius equal to @HealthRatio*100@% of the holder's max Health, and gain max Health equal to @DamageToHealthConversion*100@% of damage dealt. Radius increases every @Period@ seconds.

Recommended Roles: Attack or Magic Tank
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_RadiantField.name: Solar Eclipse

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_SearingShortb.desc:
For every @ManaPerProjectile@ mana spent, fire a projectile at a nearby enemy dealing @ProjectileDamage@ + @APScalar*100@% of the holder's Ability Power magic damage, and applying @BurnPercent@% Burn and @GrievousWoundsPercent@% Wound to enemies for @BurnDuration@ seconds.

Each projectile leaves a lingering field that deals @FieldDamagePerSecond@ magic damage to enemies each second.

Damage increases based on Stage.
Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second
Wound: Reduces healing received
Recommended Roles: Magic Caster
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_SearingShortb.name: Evolved Embershot

TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_UwuBlaster.desc:
Every attack, fire @NumUwUBlasts@ laser blasts random targets in range, dealing @ADDamage*100@% of the holder's Attack Damage as physical damage.

Recommended Roles: Attack Marksman
TFT17_AnimaSquadItem_Tier3_UwuBlaster.name: OwO Blaster

TFT17_Augment_AatroxCarry.desc: Gain an Aatrox. Your strongest Aatrox becomes an Attack Fighter with an ability that swaps between three different strikes.
TFT17_Augment_AatroxCarry.name: Stellar Combo

TFT17_Augment_AhriGodAugment.desc: Your team gains @ADAPPerLevel@% Attack Damage and Ability Power per level. Gain @XP@ XP each round for the rest of the game.
TFT17_Augment_AhriGodAugment.name: Ahri's Boon

TFT17_Augment_AnimaSquad_Commander.desc: Gain a Briar, a Jinx, and an Illaoi. Increase your current and max player Health by @PlayerHealth@.
TFT17_Augment_AnimaSquad_Commander.name: Anima Commander

TFT17_Augment_ApotheoticForge.desc:
Choose 1 of 4 Divine Artifacts.

Artifacts are more powerful items with a unique effect.
TFT17_Augment_ApotheoticForge.name: Apotheotic Forge

TFT17_Augment_Arbiter_DivineAmendment.desc:
Arbiters add a second effect to their law.
Gain a Leona and a Zoe.
TFT17_Augment_Arbiter_DivineAmendment.name: Divine Amendment

TFT17_Augment_Astronaut_KingMeep.desc:
Gain one of the four Meeplords.

(Power scales with Stage.)
TFT17_Augment_Astronaut_KingMeep.name: Meep King

TFT17_Augment_AurelionSolGodAugment.desc:
Choose 1 of @NumQuestOptions_TOOLTIPONLY@ quests to prove yourself to Aurelion Sol.

Chosen Quest: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT17_Augment_AurelionSolGodAugment@
TFT17_Augment_AurelionSolGodAugment.name: Aurelion Sol's Boon

TFT17_Augment_AurelionSolGodAugment_Boon.desc: The first time you would be eliminated, instead remain at 1 Health
TFT17_Augment_AurelionSolGodAugment_Boon.name: Boon of Resurrection

TFT17_Augment_AurelionSolGodAugment_Larg.name: After @LargeQuestRounds@ player combats, gain +1 to all non-unique traits.

TFT17_Augment_AurelionSolGodAugment_Medi.name: After @MedQuestRounds@ player combats, gain a completed item anvil and @MedQuestGold@ gold.

TFT17_Augment_AurelionSolGodAugment_Smal.desc: Your team gains @SmallQuestADAP@ Attack Damage and Ability Power.
TFT17_Augment_AurelionSolGodAugment_Smal.name: Your team gains @SmallQuestADAP@ Attack Damage and Ability Power.

TFT17_Augment_Concentration.desc: Conduit Abilities last @PowerMin@% to @PowerMax@% longer, depending on the Ability. Gain a Zoe and a Mordekaiser.
TFT17_Augment_Concentration.name: Concentration

TFT17_Augment_DarkStar_NeutronStar.desc:
Every star level of unique Dark Star units you field increases the execute threshold by @PercentPerLevel*100@%. Gain a Cho'gath and Lissandra.

Bonus Execute Percent: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT17_Augment_DarkStar_NeutronStar_BonusExecutePercent*100@%
TFT17_Augment_DarkStar_NeutronStar.name: Neutron Star

TFT17_Augment_DarkStar_WhiteHole.desc:
When the Black Hole consumes enemies, it turns them into space matter. After acquiring enough, the Black Hole turns it into loot! Gain a Cho'gath and a Lissandra.

Space matter and loot quality increase each time. Gain @TwoPiecePoints@/@FourPiecePoints@/@SixPiecePoints@ space matter depending on Dark Star breakpoint.

Space Matter: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT17_Augment_DarkStar_WhiteHole_CurrentStacks@ / @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT17_Augment_DarkStar_WhiteHole_StacksToNextCashout@
TFT17_Augment_DarkStar_WhiteHole.name: Loot Singularity

TFT17_Augment_EkkoGodAugment.desc: Gain the Anomaly, an item which grants units a powerful evolution depending on their role. Gain @NumRemovers_TOOLTIPONLY@ Magnetic Removers.
TFT17_Augment_EkkoGodAugment.name: Ekko's Boon

TFT17_Augment_EvelynnGodAugment.desc: Your team gains @Durability*100@% Durability. Lose an additional @HP@ Tactician Health when you lose combat.
TFT17_Augment_EvelynnGodAugment.name: Evelynn's Boon

TFT17_Augment_EvelynnGodAugment_BloodPri.desc: Gain @Health@ Tactician Health. Your rightmost shop slot costs Tactician Health instead of gold.
TFT17_Augment_EvelynnGodAugment_BloodPri.name: Blood Price

TFT17_Augment_GragasCarry.desc: Gain a Gragas. Your strongest Gragas becomes a Magic Fighter with a massive explosion, but also damages himself.
TFT17_Augment_GragasCarry.name: Self Destruct

TFT17_Augment_InvaderZed.desc:
Gain a Spear of Shojin. On Stage @StageNum@-@RoundNum@, gain a Zed. After receiving Zed, he can then appear in your shops.

Zed is a 5-cost Attack Fighter that creates clones of himself.
TFT17_Augment_InvaderZed.name: Invader Zed

TFT17_Augment_IvernMinionCarry.desc: Gain a Meepsie. Your strongest Meepsie becomes a Magic Fighter that leaps to a nearby hex to deal damage in a large radius.
TFT17_Augment_IvernMinionCarry.name: The Big Bang

TFT17_Augment_JaxCarry.desc: Gain a Jax. Your strongest Jax becomes a Magic Fighter that deal bonus magic damage on attack and gains stacking Attack Speed on cast.
TFT17_Augment_JaxCarry.name: Reach for the Stars

TFT17_Augment_KayleGodAugment.desc: For each unique completed item on your team, your team gains @Health@ Health, @AD*100@% Attack Damage, and @AP@% Ability Power.
TFT17_Augment_KayleGodAugment.name: Kayle's Boon

TFT17_Augment_KayleGodAugment_Scrapper.desc:
Combat start: Up to @NumComponents@ components temporarily turn into completed items. Gain @NumRemovers@ removers and a salvager.

Salvagers allow you to break completed items into components
TFT17_Augment_KayleGodAugment_Scrapper.name: Boon of the Scrapper

TFT17_Augment_LeonaCarry.desc: Gain a Leona. Your strongest Leona becomes an Attack Fighter that dashes through enemies to deal physical damage, stunning the first target hit.
TFT17_Augment_LeonaCarry.name: Shieldmaiden

TFT17_Augment_MordekaiserCarry.desc: Gain a Mordekaiser. Your strongest Mordkaiser becomes a Magic Fighter with a slowly growing aura that deals damage over time.
TFT17_Augment_MordekaiserCarry.name: Heat Death

TFT17_Augment_NasusCarry.desc: Gain a Nasus. Your strongest Nasus becomes an Attack Fighter with a single target Ability that gets stronger with each kill.
TFT17_Augment_NasusCarry.name: Bonk!

TFT17_Augment_PoppyCarry.desc: Gain a Poppy. Your strongest Poppy becomes a ranged Attack Caster that flings a high-velocity Meep at her target.
TFT17_Augment_PoppyCarry.name: Termeepnal Velocity

TFT17_Augment_PrimordianPrismaticAugment.desc:
All 3-star champions now count towards Swarmling power. At level @LevelRequirement@, while fielding @Num3StarUnits@ unique 3-star champions, Primordians summon the Apex Primordian. Gain 3 Primordian Champions and 2 Tiny Duplicators.

Unique 3-Star Champions Fielded: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT17_Augment_PrimordianPrismaticAugment_TotalStarredUnits@ / @Num3StarUnits@

Levels: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT17_Augment_PrimordianPrismaticAugment_TotalLevel@ / @LevelRequirement@
TFT17_Augment_PrimordianPrismaticAugment.name: Heart of the Swarm

TFT17_Augment_PykeCarry.desc: Gain a Pyke. Your strongest Pyke becomes an Attack Fighter, generates gold on team takedown, and gains a reset on-kill Ability.
TFT17_Augment_PykeCarry.name: Contract Killer

TFT17_Augment_ShepherdAugment.desc: On Stage @StageNum@-@RoundNum@, gain a Sona and a Shepherd Emblem.
TFT17_Augment_ShepherdAugment.name: Shepherd's Song

TFT17_Augment_ShieldTank_DivinePaladins.desc: Vanguard shields are @PercentStronger*100@% stronger and explode when broken, dealing @Damage@ magic damage split between enemies in a @Hex@-hex radius.
TFT17_Augment_ShieldTank_DivinePaladins.name: Divine Paladins

TFT17_Augment_SnipersNest.desc: Snipers gain @DamageAmp@% Damage Amp for each combat fought from the same starting hex, up to @MaxAmp@%. Gain an Ezreal and a Gnar.
TFT17_Augment_SnipersNest.name: Sniper's Nest

TFT17_Augment_SorakaGodAugment.desc: Your team gains @HealthPerTacHealth@ Health for each missing player health. At the start of each player combat, gain an additional @Heal@ player health.
TFT17_Augment_SorakaGodAugment.name: Soraka's Boon

TFT17_Augment_ThreshGodAugment.desc:
Each round, roll a die. Get a bonus based on that roll.


Health: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT17_ThreshGodAugment_Health@
Attack Speed: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT17_ThreshGodAugment_AttackSpeed@%

Marked enemies are struck by a cannonball after @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.1:BarrageInterval@ seconds, dealing the stored damage plus a flat value as physical damage.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.1:Damage@ + @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.1:DamagePercent@% damage dealt
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.2:Damage@ + @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.2:DamagePercent@% damage dealt. Every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.2:ShotsUntilTreasure@th cannonball is replaced with a treasure chest that drops gold!

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitBossActivator.desc:
Gain Boss Knuckles. When the holder first drops below @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.1:HealthThreshold*100@% Health, they become The Boss and leave combat to start doing sit-ups. Each sit-up restores maximum Health and grants Attack Speed.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.1:HealPercent*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.1:AttackSpeedPercent*100@% %i:scaleAS%.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.2:HealPercent*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.2:AttackSpeedPercent*100@% %i:scaleAS%. If they reach full Health they return to combat Pumped Up: all of their attacks and abilities deal @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.2:TrueDamagePercentage*100@% of damage as true damage.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitBossActivator.name: The Boss

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitConquerorActivato.desc:

Your team gains Attack Damage and Ability Power, increased by @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror:PercentIncreasePerChest*100@% for each War Chest opened.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.1:ADAPBase*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%; @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.1:StacksPerKill@x Conquest
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.2:ADAPBase*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%; @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.2:StacksPerKill@x Conquest

Current Stats: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror_CurrentADAP@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitConquerorActivato.name: Conqueror

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitCovenActivator.desc:
The unit nearest to the center of your team is chosen as the Coven Leader, gaining bonus Ability Power.

Whenever your team casts an Ability, the Coven Leader gains Mana.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Coven.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Coven.1:AbilityPower@ %i:scaleAP%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Coven.1:ManaToGive@ %i:scaleMana%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Coven.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Coven.2:AbilityPower@ %i:scaleAP%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Coven.2:ManaToGive@ %i:scaleMana%

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Crystal.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Crystal.1:DamageThreshold@ max damage, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Crystal.1:Duration@ seconds.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Crystal.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Crystal.2:DamageThreshold@ max damage, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Crystal.2:Duration@ seconds.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitCrystalActivator.name: Crystal

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitDemaciaActivator.desc:
Each time your team loses @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.1:MaxHealthLost*100@% max Health, they Rally, reducing their Mana cost by @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.1:ManaReductionPct*100@%. Your team gains Armor and Magic Resist.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.1:ArmorMR@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.2:ArmorMR@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%. Unlock Galio. On Rally, reduce Mana costs of your team by @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.2:ManaReductionPctPerGalioItem*100@% for each item equipped to your strongest Galio, and smite enemies for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.2:EnemyTrueDamage*100@% of their max Health.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitDemaciaActivator.name: Demacia

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitDragonlordActivat.desc:
After @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:FirstDelay@ seconds of combat, the Dragon strikes the board, dealing true damage and stunning all enemies. Allies gain Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:TrueDamageHPRatio*100@% %i:scaleHealth% damage, Stuns for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:StunDuration@ seconds, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:AttackSpeedBuff*100@% %i:scaleAS%.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:TrueDamageHPRatio*100@% %i:scaleHealth% damage, Stuns for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:StunDuration@ seconds, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:AttackSpeedBuff*100@% %i:scaleAS%.
After an additional @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:SecondDelay@ seconds, the Dragon strikes again.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitDragonlordActivat.name: Dragonlord

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitElderwoodActivato.desc:
Every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.1:TickRate@ seconds your team grows, gaining bonus stats. This effect stacks up to @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.1:MaxStacks@ times.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.1:BonusResists@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.1:BonusADSP@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.2:BonusResists@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.2:BonusADSP@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitElderwoodActivato.name: Elderwood

Gain a Lavender Crown. After the first @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Empress.1:DelayForInitialCoralSpawn@ seconds of combat, spawn a Void Coral near the holder's current target.
The holder blinks to the Coral's location and consumes it, gaining max Health, Attack Damage, and Ability Power, and deals magic damage to enemies within @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Empress.1:HexRange@ hexes.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Empress.1:MinUnits@) Coral grants @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Empress.1:PercentBonusMaxHealth*100@% max Health increase, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Empress.1:BonusAD*100@% %i:scaleAD% %i:scaleAP%.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Empress.2:MinUnits@) Kills now leave behind additional Void Corals. First Coral grants @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Empress.2:PercentBonusMaxHealth*100@% max Health increase and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Empress.2:BonusAD*100@% %i:scaleAD% %i:scaleAP%; consuming further Corals heal the holder for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Empress.2:PercentHealthHeal*100@% %i:scaleHealth% and grant an additional @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Empress.2:StackingBonusAD*100@% %i:scaleAD% %i:scaleAP%.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitEmpressActivator.name: Empress

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitFatedActivator.desc:
Hover one champion over another to form a pair and unlock a Fated Bonus, based on the role of the champions.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Fated.1:MinUnits@) Pair gets the Fated Bonus and gains @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Fated.1:PairHPBonus*100@% max Health.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Fated.2:MinUnits@) ALL units get the Fated Bonus. The pair gets gains @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Fated.1:PairHPBonus*100@% max Health and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Fated.2:PairBondIncreasePercent*100@% of the Fated Bonus.

Fated Bonuses:
Assassins: @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Fated.1:YasuoBuffBonus@ Shield on combat start
Casters: @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Fated.1:AhriBuffBonus*100@% %i:scaleAD% %i:scaleAP%
Fighters: @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Fated.1:SettBuffBonus*100@% %i:scaleSV%
Marksmen: @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Fated.1:KindredBuffBonus*100@% %i:scaleAS%
Specialists: Deal @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Fated.1:SyndraBuffBonus*100@% of damage as true damage
Tanks: @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Fated.1:ThreshBuffBonus@ %i:scaleArmor% %i:scaleMR%

Your units can only benefit from a single instance of a specific fated bonus.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitFatedActivator.name: Fated

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitGhostlyActivator.desc:
Upon dealing or taking damage @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ghostly:NumInstances@ times, units send @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ghostly:NumSpectres@ spectres to haunt nearby enemies and heal @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ghostly:HealingPercent*100@% max Health every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ghostly:TickRate@ seconds.

Haunted enemies take bonus damage for each spectre on them, and pass spectres on death.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ghostly.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ghostly.1:DamagePercent*100@% per spectre
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ghostly.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ghostly.2:DamagePercent*100@% per spectre
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitGhostlyActivator.name: Ghostly

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitGlacialActivator.desc:
