(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.1:BonusDamage@ magic damage.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.2:BonusDamage@ magic damage. Gain another Glacial Mallet.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitGlacialActivator.name: Glacial

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitHackerActivator.desc:
Your team gains Omnivamp and summons a H4ckerr!m. Enemies it passes through are H4ck3d, losing @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hacker.1:PercentArmorToRemove*100@% of their Armor and Magic Resist.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hacker.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hacker.1:Omnivamp*100@% %i:scaleSV%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hacker.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hacker.2:Omnivamp*100@% %i:scaleSV%, AND see your next opponent. Gain a rider hex that sends its unit to the enemy backline at combat start. The rider gains @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hacker.2:Horsevamp*100@% %i:scaleSV% instead, and their kills have a @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hacker.2:PercentChanceToDropGoldOnKill*100@% chance to drop 1 gold.

When an allied champion dies, a Doppelhellion (a one less star copy) equipped with a Red Buff will leap from the Hellion portal and join the fight!

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hellion.1:MinUnits@) The first @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hellion.1:NumOfUnits@ champions
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hellion.2:MinUnits@) The first @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hellion.2:NumOfUnits@ champions
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitHellionActivator.name: Hellion

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitHighRollerActivat.desc:
Gain a Sevika's Jinxed Arm!

Combat start: roll a random Jinx mod. Roll another one:
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.1:MinUnits@) after @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.1:RollingFrequency@ seconds.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.2:MinUnits@) every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.2:RollingFrequency@ seconds. Mods are stronger, and the holder can now hit a Jinxed Jackpot!

Mods:
- Rocket: Launch rockets at random enemies.
- Shield: Gain a shield for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.1:Spell2ShieldDuration@ seconds.
- Coin: Gain gold.

Rockets Fired: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller_RocketsFired@
Shields Gained: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller_ShieldsGained@
Gold Gained: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller_GoldGained@
Jackpots Hit: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller_JackpotsHit@
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitHighRollerActivat.name: High Roller

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitHoneymancyActivat.desc:
Your team gains Bees that deal magic damage to their targets every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy:Period@ seconds. Bee damage is based on the damage dealt and taken by the host, plus a flat amount per Bee.

When a unit dies, they leave @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy:NumTransfers@ bees that follow nearby allies for the rest of combat.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.1:MiniCount@ Bees, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.1:BonusDamage*100@% Damage dealt, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.1:DamageReceived*100@% damage taken, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.1:DamagePerMini@ damage per Bee.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.2:MiniCount@ Bees, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.2:BonusDamage*100@% Damage dealt, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.2:DamageReceived*100@% damage taken, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.2:DamagePerMini@ damage per Bee.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitHoneymancyActivat.name: Honeymancy

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitImperialActivator.desc:
Combat start: select champions gain @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Imperial.1:DamageAmp*100@% %i:scaleDA%.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Imperial.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Imperial.1:NumOfUnits@ random champions.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Imperial.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Imperial.2:NumOfUnits@ random champions.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitImperialActivator.name: Imperial

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitIxtalActivator.desc:
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ixtal.1:MinUnits@) Complete Quests to earn Sunshards (%i:Set16Ixtal%) and spend them for loot!
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ixtal.2:MinUnits@) Heal 2 player health at the start of player combat. Find @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ixtal.2:BonusClues@ %i:Set16Ixtal% at the end of combat, and you can now unlock Brock after reaching 500 %i:Set16Ixtal%!

Completing a Quest before combat ends grants you a new one at the start of next round.

Total Sunshards Earned: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Explorer_TotalExplorerPoints@ %i:Set16Ixtal%
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitIxtalActivator.name: Ixtal

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitJazzActivator.desc:
For each active trait, your team gains bonus Health and Damage Amp.
(Excludes unique and Anniversary Traits)

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.1:BonusHealth*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.1:BonusDamage*100@% %i:scaleDA%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.2:BonusHealth*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.2:BonusDamage*100@% %i:scaleDA%

Bonus Health: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT10_Trait_Jazz_TraitTracker_CurrentBonus@%
Bonus Damage Amp: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT10_Trait_Jazz_TraitTracker_CurrentBonus_Damage@%
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitJazzActivator.name: Jazz

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitLaserCorpsActivat.desc:
Your team gains laser drones. When a unit attacks or is hit by an attack, their drone deals magic damage to the target (@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_LaserCorps.1:ICD@ second cooldown). Drones are reassigned to another ally on death.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_LaserCorps.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_LaserCorps.1:MagicDamage@ magic damage.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_LaserCorps.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_LaserCorps.2:MagicDamage@ magic damage. All units gain an additional drone.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitLaserCorpsActivat.name: LaserCorps

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitMaestroActivator.desc:
Gain a Maestro's Baton.
The holder has a fixed Attack Speed, and converts bonus Attack Speed to Attack Damage.

Every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Maestro.1:NumAutosToSpawnJhinGun@ attacks, the Maestro summons a Grand Finale Rifle into one of your empty bench slots, up to 4. After summoning 4, they fire at the same rate as the Maestro, dealing physical damage.
Every 4th volley is Harmonic, dealing a percentage of the total damage the Maestro and their Rifles have done since the last Harmonic volley.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Maestro.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Maestro.1:EmpoweredShotEchoDamagePercentage*100@% Harmonic Damage.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Maestro.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Maestro.2:EmpoweredShotEchoDamagePercentage*100@% Harmonic Damage.
The Maestro can summon more than 4 Rifles. Combat Start: summon 1 Rifle into an empty bench slot.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitMaestroActivator.name: Maestro

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitMascotActivator.desc:
Your team heals a percentage of their max Health every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.1:Seconds@ seconds.

When a champion dies, they retreat to the sidelines to cheer on your team. Your team's healing increases for each cheering champion.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.1:BaseHealthRegen@% %i:scaleHealth% base, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.1:HealthRegenPerMascot@% %i:scaleHealth% per cheering champion
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.2:BaseHealthRegen@% %i:scaleHealth% base, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.2:HealthRegenPerMascot@% %i:scaleHealth% per cheering champion
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitMascotActivator.name: Mascot

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitMechPilotActivato.desc:
Use the Pilot Selector to choose a Pilot. Combat start: the Pilot jumps into a Mech.

The Mech has the traits and items of its Pilot, and gains a percent of the pilot's Attack Damage and max Health. When the Mech dies, the Pilot(s) are ejected with @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.1:EjectedPilotHealthPercent@% of their max Health.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.1:MinUnits@) Mini-Mech: @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.1:MechCombinedADRatio*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.2:MinUnits@) Super-Mech: @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.2:MechCombinedADRatio*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth%. The 2 nearest units to the Pilot also jump into the Mech.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitMechPilotActivato.name: Mech-Pilot

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitMountainActivator.desc:
Gain 2 Mountain hexes in the front row.
Combat start: units standing on a Mountain hex gain a Shield and permanent bonus Health.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.1:ShieldValue@ Shield, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.1:PermBonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.2:ShieldValue@ Shield, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.2:PermBonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%. The entire front row becomes Mountain hexes.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitMountainActivator.name: Mountain

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitNitroActivator.desc:
After every player combat, your champions grant Chrome to R-080T, based on their star level. Each Chrome grants @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Nitro.:HealthPerScrap@ Health and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Nitro.:APPerScrap@ Ability Power.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Nitro.1:MinUnits@) Summon R-080T!
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Nitro.2:MinUnits@) Upgrade R-080T to T-43X! At @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Nitro.:FourStarScrapThreshold@ Chrome, upgrade T-43X to fire a giant laser!

Chrome per star: @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Nitro.:ScrapPerOneStar@/@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Nitro.:ScrapPerTwoStar@/@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Nitro.:ScrapPerThreeStar@/@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Nitro.:ScrapPerFourStar@
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitNitroActivator.name: Nitro

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitOverlordActivator.desc:
Use the Overlord Selector to choose an Overlord.

The Overlord takes a bite out of the unit in the hex behind them, dealing true damage to that unit.
The Overlord gains the same amount of health as the chomp deals, and gains a percentage of that unit's Attack Damage and Ability Power.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Overlord.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Overlord.1:HPPercentDamage*100@% max Health true damage, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Overlord.1:PercentADAPGain*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Overlord.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Overlord.2:HPPercentDamage*100@% max Health true damage, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Overlord.2:PercentADAPGain*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%.
Take a bite out of two units. Damage from the Overlord's attacks and abilities 30% Shred, 30% Sunder, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Overlord.2:EnemyDamageReduction*100@% Weaken, and 33% Wound enemies for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Overlord.2:DebuffDuration@ seconds. These effects do not stack.

Shred: Reduce Magic Resist
Sunder: Reduce Armor
Weaken: Reduce Damage dealt
Wound: Reduces healing received
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitOverlordActivator.name: Overlord

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitPentakillActivato.desc:
Your team gains @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.1:Damage_Reduction*100@% Durability and Damage Amp. For each champion kill, a champion on your team rocks out, increasing this bonus Damage Amp by @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.:Kill_Bonus*100@%.

On the @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.:Kill_Count@th kill, your entire team rocks out and gains Attack Speed.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.1:Bonus_Damage*100@% %i:scaleDA%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.1:Attack_Speed*100@% Attack Speed after a Pentakill.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.2:Bonus_Damage*100@% %i:scaleDA%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.2:Attack_Speed*100@% Attack Speed after a Pentakill.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitPentakillActivato.name: Pentakill

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitPhantomActivator.desc:
Combat start: random enemies have their Health reduced.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Phantom.1:MinUnits@) Set @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Phantom.1:NumUnitsToReduce@ enemy's Health to @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Phantom.1:PercentHealth*100@% maximum Health.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Phantom.2:MinUnits@) Set @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Phantom.2:NumUnitsToReduce@ enemies' Health to @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Phantom.2:FlatHealth@.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitPhantomActivator.name: Phantom

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitPreserverActivato.desc:
Your team heals for a percent of their max Health every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.1:Duration@ seconds. If they are full Health, restore Mana instead.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.1:HealthPct*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, or @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.1:ManaPct*100@% %i:scaleMana%.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.2:HealthPct*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.2:ManaPct*100@% %i:scaleMana%. Always get both.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitPreserverActivato.name: Renewer

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitPunkActivator.desc:
Your team gain bonus Health, Attack Damage and Ability Power, which increases by 1% every time you spend gold on a Shop reroll.

After each combat, gain a 1 gold reroll for that round. Your first reroll each round grants @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk:FIRST_ROLL_BONUS@% bonus instead!

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.1:MinUnits@ )@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.1:BONUS_HEALTH@ %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.1:BONUS_AD_AP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.2:MinUnits@ )@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.2:BONUS_HEALTH@ %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.2:BONUS_AD_AP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%

Current Bonus: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Punk_CurrentBonus@%
@TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Punk_CurrentHealthBonus@ %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Punk_CurrentADBonus@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitPunkActivator.name: Punk

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitPyroActivator.desc:
Your team gains @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro:BaseASPct@% %i:scaleAS% Attack Speed.

For each kill, your team creates an infernal cinder that you collect the next round. For every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro:NumCinders@ cinders you collect, your team gains @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro:ASPctPerNumCinders@% more %i:scaleAS%.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.1:NumCindersPerKill@ infernal cinder per enemy.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.2:NumCindersPerKill@ infernal cinders per enemy and execute enemies under @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.2:ExecutePct@% Health.

Cinders collected: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_PyroCindersCollected@
Team %i:scaleAS%: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_PyroAttackSpeed@%
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitPyroActivator.name: Pyro

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitRebelActivator.desc:
Your team gains a Shield and Damage Amp for each adjacent ally.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.1:ShieldAmount@ Shield for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.1:ShieldDuration@ seconds, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.1:DamageAmp@% %i:scaleDA%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.2:ShieldAmount@ Shield for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.2:ShieldDuration@ seconds, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.2:DamageAmp@% %i:scaleDA%
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitRebelActivator.name: Rebel

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitShimmerscaleActiv.desc:
Gain Shimmerscale items. These items give gold as well as combat power.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shimmerscale.1:MinUnits@) Gain Goldmancers Staff. At Stage @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shimmerscale.1:SecondItemStage@-@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shimmerscale.1:SecondItemRound@ gain Draven's Axe.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shimmerscale.2:MinUnits@) Gain Crown of Champions.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitShimmerscaleActiv.name: Shimmerscale

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitShurimaActivator.desc:
Combat start: select champions Ascend and gain @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.1:BonusHealthPercent*100@% maximum Health %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.1:BonusASPercent*100@% Attack Speed %i:scaleAS%.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.1:MinUnits@) The strongest champion Ascends after @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.1:SecondsToAscend@ seconds.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.2:MinUnits@) The @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.2:NumUnitsToAscend@ strongest champions Ascend immediately.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitShurimaActivator.name: Shurima

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitSocialiteActivato.desc:
Gain a spotlight hex.
Combat start: the unit standing in the spotlight gains bonus stats.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.1:DamagePercent*100@% %i:scaleDA% and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.1:ManaPerSecond@ %i:scaleMana% per second.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.2:DamagePercent*100@% %i:scaleDA%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.2:ManaPerSecond@ %i:scaleMana% per second, and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.2:OmnivampPercent*100@% %i:scaleSV%. Gain another spotlight hex.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitSocialiteActivato.name: Socialite

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitStoryweaverActiva.desc:
Summon a Hero named Kayle and evolve her as you level up!

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver.1:MinUnits@) When you reach level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:FirstArmoryLevel@, Kayle upgrades to 2-star. Pick a supportive effect.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver.2:MinUnits@) Kayle evolves again at levels @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:SecondArmoryLevel@, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:ThirdArmoryLevel@ and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:FourStarUpgradeLevel@:
Level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:SecondArmoryLevel@: Pick a combat effect.
Level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:ThirdArmoryLevel@: Kayle upgrades to 3-star. Pick a combat effect.
Level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:FourStarUpgradeLevel@: Kayle upgrades to 4-star.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitStoryweaverActiva.name: Storyweaver

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitTheCrewActivator.desc:
Summon the Nocturnus to aid you in battle! It fires a rocket that deals @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:BaseRocketDamage@ magic damage every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:BaseDamageThreshold@ damage your team deals.

2-cost and higher champions become Crew members after reaching 3-star. Gain additional bonuses for each Crew member.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:MinUnits@) 2 max Crew members.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.2:MinUnits@) 4 maximum Crew members.

(1x %i:3StarEnabled%): + @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:OnARollRolls@ free rerolls when you star up a unit you fielded last combat.
(2x %i:3StarEnabled%): Rockets deal @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:UpgradedRocketDamage@ damage.
(3x %i:3StarEnabled%): + @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:FreeRerollsPerRound@ free reroll / round.
(4x %i:3StarEnabled%): Rockets fire every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:UpgradedDamageThreshold@ damage dealt. Gain @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:XPPerRound@ XP per round.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitTheCrewActivator.name: The Crew

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitTrainerActivator.desc:
After combat, the 3 champions closest to Nomsy feed her 1 Snax per star level, adding Health and Ability Power. Nomsy's star level increases every 25 Snax!

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Trainer.1:MinUnits@) Summon Nomsy!
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Trainer.2:MinUnits@) Nomsy's Ability deals @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Trainer.2:DamageInc*100@% bonus damage
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitTrainerActivator.name: Trainer

TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitYordleActivator.desc:
After each player combat, gain a Yordle Grab Bag full of Yordle-y loot!

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Yordle.1:MinUnits@) Gain a Yordle Grab Bag!
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Yordle.2:MinUnits@) If you fielded @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Yordle.2:NumOfThreeStarsNeeded@ or more 3-star champions, your Yordle Grab Bag will contain a Yordle-Lord.
TFTEvent_5YR_Item_TraitYordleActivator.name: Yordle

TFTEvent_PM_Augment_TradeSector.desc: Gain a free Shop reroll every round. Gain @Gold@ gold.
TFTEvent_PM_Augment_TradeSector.name: Trade Sector

TFTEvent_SF_Item_PowerUp_Rank1.desc:
Contribute +1 to the last listed Trait. (Unique traits excluded.)

A new effect unlocks at the start of the tournament (4-1).

[Cannot be used on champions in combat.]
[Unlimited uses.]
TFTEvent_SF_Item_PowerUp_Rank1.name: Imperfect Soul Crown

TFTEvent_SF_Item_PowerUp_Rank4.desc:
Prevents the holder's first death. When they revive after 2 seconds, they shed all negative effects and gain @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Event_SF_SoulCrownHealthRestore@ Health (double your Soul Power).

Contribute +1 to the last listed Trait. (Unique traits excluded.)

[Cannot be used on champions in combat.]
[Unlimited uses.]
TFTEvent_SF_Item_PowerUp_Rank4.name: Soul Crown

TFTTutorial_Augment_AbilityPwr.name: Tons of Stats!

TFTTutorial_Augment_Armor.name: Tons of Stats!

TFTTutorial_Augment_AtkDmg.desc: Your team gains @Health@ Health, @AttackDamage@% Attack Damage, @AbilityPower@% Ability Power, @Armor@ Armor, @MR@ Magic Resist, @AttackSpeed@% Attack Speed, and @Mana@ Mana.
TFTTutorial_Augment_AtkDmg.name: Tons of Stats!

TFTTutorial_Augment_AtkSpeed.desc: Your team gains @Health@ Health, @AttackDamage@% Attack Damage, @AbilityPower@% Ability Power, @Armor@ Armor, @MR@ Magic Resist, @AttackSpeed@% Attack Speed, and @Mana@ Mana.
TFTTutorial_Augment_AtkSpeed.name: Tons of Stats!

TFTTutorial_Augment_BackRowAS1.desc: Combat start: Your champions in the back 2 rows gain @AS*100@ Attack Speed.
TFTTutorial_Augment_BackRowAS1.name: Swift Strike

TFTTutorial_Augment_FrontRowHealth1.desc: Combat start: Your champions in the front 2 rows gain @Health@ Health.
TFTTutorial_Augment_FrontRowHealth1.name: Bulwark

TFTTutorial_Augment_FrontRowMana1.desc: Combat start: Your champions in the front 2 rows gain @Mana@ Mana.
TFTTutorial_Augment_FrontRowMana1.name: Splash Zone

TFTTutorial_Augment_Health.desc: Your team gains @Health@ Health, @AttackDamage@% Attack Damage, @AbilityPower@% Ability Power, @Armor@ Armor, @MR@ Magic Resist, @AttackSpeed@% Attack Speed, and @Mana@ Mana.
TFTTutorial_Augment_Health.name: Tons of Stats!

TFTTutorial_Augment_MR.desc: Your team gains @Health@ Health, @AttackDamage@% Attack Damage, @AbilityPower@% Ability Power, @Armor@ Armor, @MR@ Magic Resist, @AttackSpeed@% Attack Speed, and @Mana@ Mana.
TFTTutorial_Augment_MR.name: Tons of Stats!

TFTTutorial_Augment_Mana.desc: Your team gains @Health@ Health, @AttackDamage@% Attack Damage, @AbilityPower@% Ability Power, @Armor@ Armor, @MR@ Magic Resist, @AttackSpeed@% Attack Speed, and @Mana@ Mana.
TFTTutorial_Augment_Mana.name: Tons of Stats!

TFTTutorial_Augment_WithItemAS2.desc: Your champions holding an item gain @AttackSpeed*100@ Attack Speed.
TFTTutorial_Augment_WithItemAS2.name: Elite Vanguard

TFTTutorial_Augment_WithItemHealth2.desc: Your champions holding an item gain @Health@ Health.
TFTTutorial_Augment_WithItemHealth2.name: Cybernetic Mass

TFTTutorial_Augment_WithoutItemAS2.desc: Your champions without items gain @AttackSpeed*100@ Attack Speed.
TFTTutorial_Augment_WithoutItemAS2.name: Unhindered

TFTTutorial_Item_BlueBuff.desc:
Gain @ManaRefund@ Mana after casting.

When the holder gets a takedown, they deal @DamageAmp*100@% more damage for @TakedownTimer@ seconds.

[Unique - only 1 per champion]
TFTTutorial_Item_BlueBuff.name: Blue Buff

TFTTutorial_Item_GuardianAngel.desc:
Prevents the holder's first death, placing them in stasis instead. After @StasisDuration@ seconds, they return with @HealthRestore@ Health and shed all negative effects.

[Unique - Only One Per Champion]
TFTTutorial_Item_GuardianAngel.name: Guardian Angel

TFTTutorial_Item_GuinsoosRageblade.desc: Attacks grant %i:scaleAS% @AttackSpeedPerStack@% bonus Attack Speed. This effect stacks.
TFTTutorial_Item_GuinsoosRageblade.name: Guinsoo's Rageblade

TFT_Assist_AllDoubleNonSpatItems.desc: Deathblade, Rabadon's Deathcap, Red Buff, Bramble Vest, Dragon's Claw, Warmog's Armor, Blue Buff, Thief's Gloves.
TFT_Assist_AllDoubleNonSpatItems.name: All double component items

TFT_Assist_Dummy_2xLocked.desc: A training dummy with 2 Lockets of The Iron Solari, an item which shields allies on combat start.
TFT_Assist_Dummy_2xLocked.name: Dummy with 2 Lockets

TFT_Assist_Dummy_2xZekes.desc: A training dummy with 2 Zeke's Heralds, which provides Attack Speed to nearby allies.
TFT_Assist_Dummy_2xZekes.name: Dummy with 2 Zeke's

TFT_Assist_Dummy_Shroud.desc: A training dummy with a Shroud of Stillness, an item which increases enemies' mana costs.
TFT_Assist_Dummy_Shroud.name: Dummy with Shroud

TFT_Assist_Golem_2xAegis.desc: A golem with 2 Aegises of the Legion, an item which provides Armor, Magic Resist, and Attack Speed to allies behind it.
TFT_Assist_Golem_2xAegis.name: Golem with 2 Aegises.

TFT_Assist_LesserRuneOfAllegiance.desc:
Place on a Tier 1, 2, or 3 champion to transfer them to your partner. Any items held will pop off.

Once used, this item regenerates in @RoundsToRegain@ rounds. At 4-1 it upgrades into a Rune of Allegiance.

[Cannot be used in combat.]
[CONSUMABLE - This item disappears when used.]
TFT_Assist_LesserRuneOfAllegiance.name: Lesser Rune of Allegiance

TFT_Assist_RuneOfAllegiance.desc:
Use on any champion to transfer them to your partner. Any items held will pop off.

Once used, this item regenerates in @RoundsToRegain@ rounds.

[Cannot be used in combat.]
[Consumable - this item disappears when used.]
TFT_Assist_RuneOfAllegiance.name: Rune of Allegiance

TFT_Augment_AHeroArrives.desc: After @Delay@ seconds, the left-most champion on your bench enters combat with @BonusHP*100@% bonus Health, stunning enemies within @StunHexArea@-hexes for @StunDuration@ seconds.
TFT_Augment_AHeroArrives.name: A Hero Arrives!

TFT_Augment_AbilityAmplification.desc: Your team gains @AP@% stacking Ability Power every time they attack, up to @maxstacks@ stacks.
TFT_Augment_AbilityAmplification.name: Spellblade

TFT_Augment_AdvancedLoan.desc: Gain @Gold@ Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.
TFT_Augment_AdvancedLoan.name: Advanced Loan

TFT_Augment_AdvancedLoanPlus.desc: Gain @Gold@ Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.
TFT_Augment_AdvancedLoanPlus.name: Advanced Loan+

TFT_Augment_AimForTheTop.desc:
You are more likely to fight stronger players, and you know who you will fight. When you lose, gain @XP@ XP. After your first win and every @WinsPerComponent@ wins after, gain a component.

Foes vanquished: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT15_AimForTheTop_EnemiesBeaten@
TFT_Augment_AimForTheTop.name: Aim For The Top!

TFT_Augment_AllForOneI.desc: Your team gains @PercHP*100@% max Health and @DamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp for each unique one-cost champion on your board. Gain @NumChampsToGrant@ one-costs.
TFT_Augment_AllForOneI.name: One For All I

TFT_Augment_AllForOneII.desc: Your team gains @PercHP*100@% max Health and @DamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp for each unique one-cost champion on your board. Gain @NumChampsToGrant@ one-costs.
TFT_Augment_AllForOneII.name: One For All II

TFT_Augment_AllIn.desc:
Get a Training Manual. Once per round, use the Training Manual on a champion to spend five gold and give them @HealthBonus@ Health and @ASBonus@ Attack Speed.

@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_ALLin_Tooltip@
TFT_Augment_AllIn.name: Training Manual

TFT_Augment_AllThatShimmersPlus.desc: Choose a gold-generating Artifact. Gain a Magnetic Remover and @GoldGranted@ gold.
TFT_Augment_AllThatShimmersPlus.name: All That Shimmers+

TFT_Augment_AnExaltedAdventure.desc:
Gain three 2-cost champions. If you 3-star two of them, gain an orb filled with loot. Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator at the start of next @NumStages@ stages.

Champions: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_ExaltedAdventure_Champs@, @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_ExaltedAdventure_Champs2@, @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_ExaltedAdventure_Champs3@
TFT_Augment_AnExaltedAdventure.name: An Exalted Adventure

TFT_Augment_AnUpgradedJourney.desc: After upgrading @NumUpgrades@ champions to 3-star, gain a magnificent reward. Gain @NumStartUnits@ 1-cost champions.
TFT_Augment_AnUpgradedJourney.name: An Upgraded Adventure

TFT_Augment_AnotherOne.desc: The next completed item you make grants an additional copy of it. Gain @Gold@ gold now.
TFT_Augment_AnotherOne.name: Another One!

TFT_Augment_AnotherOnePlus.desc: The next completed item you make grants another copy of it. Gain @NumComponents@ component anvil.
TFT_Augment_AnotherOnePlus.name: Another One!+

TFT_Augment_ArcaneViktory.desc:
After @FirstStunSeconds@ seconds of combat, stun the enemy team for @StunDuration@ seconds. Repeat this after @SecondStunSeconds@ seconds of combat.

TFT Macao Open, 2024
TFT_Augment_ArcaneViktory.name: Arcane Viktor-y

TFT_Augment_Artifactory.desc: At the start of each turn, your benched completed items transform into a random Artifact item. Gain @NumItems@ Artifact Anvil and @NumRemovers@ Removers.
TFT_Augment_Artifactory.name: Artifactory

TFT_Augment_AssassinsToolbox.desc: Gain a Prowler's Claw and an Infinity Edge.
TFT_Augment_AssassinsToolbox.name: Assassin's Toolbox

TFT_Augment_AuraFarming.desc: Gain a @StarLevel@-star 5-cost champion holding a recommended item. You cannot field it until Stage @UnlockStage@-@UnlockRound@.
TFT_Augment_AuraFarming.name: Aura Farming

TFT_Augment_AvengeTheFallen.desc: After @NumDeaths@ allies die, your team gains @AD@% Attack Damage, @ap@ Ability Power, @Armor@ Armor, and @MR@ Magic Resist.
TFT_Augment_AvengeTheFallen.name: Avenge The Fallen

TFT_Augment_AwakenedSoul.desc: Combat start: Your team gains @StatsPerSecond@% Attack Damage and Ability Power per second for @MaxStacks@ seconds. At max stacks, deal @BonusTrueDamage*100@% bonus true damage.
TFT_Augment_AwakenedSoul.name: Soul Awakening

TFT_Augment_AxiomArc3.desc: Your allies gain @ManaGain@ Mana on kill. Gain a completed item Anvil.
TFT_Augment_AxiomArc3.name: Axiom Arc III

TFT_Augment_BRB.desc: You cannot perform actions for the next @RoundsToSkip@ rounds. Afterwards, gain @Anvils@ completed item anvils.
TFT_Augment_BRB.name: BRB

TFT_Augment_BacklineBlueprint.desc: Gain a 3-cost non-Tank champion and an Emblem that matches their last-listed trait.
TFT_Augment_BacklineBlueprint.name: Backline Blueprint

TFT_Augment_Backup.desc: Your team gains @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed if at least @MinUnits@ allies start combat in the back two rows.
TFT_Augment_Backup.name: Backup

TFT_Augment_BackupDancers.desc: Combat start:  Every @Period@ seconds, champions in your @BenchSlots@ rightmost bench slots grant your team @AttackSpeedPerUnit*100@% Attack Speed per slot.
TFT_Augment_BackupDancers.name: Backup Dancers

TFT_Augment_BadLuckProtection.desc: Your team can no longer critically strike. Convert each @CritChancePercent@% Critical Strike Chance into @ADPerCrit*100@% Attack Damage. Gain a Sparring Gloves.
TFT_Augment_BadLuckProtection.name: Bad Luck Protection

TFT_Augment_BadOdds.desc: You can only reach even levels, but the XP cost to each level is reduced. Gain @StartingXP@ XP.
TFT_Augment_BadOdds.name: Bad Odds

TFT_Augment_BeggarsCanBeChoosers.desc: You get +@ExtraRolls@ Augment rerolls for all other augment choices. Gain @Gold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_BeggarsCanBeChoosers.name: Beggars Can Be Choosers

TFT_Augment_BeltOverflow.desc: Gain @NumItems@ Giant's Belts. Your Giant's Belts grant +@BonusHealth@ bonus Health.
TFT_Augment_BeltOverflow.name: Belt Overflow

TFT_Augment_BigOnes.desc: Combat start: Your 1-cost champions gain @Health@ max Health and @DamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp.
TFT_Augment_BigOnes.name: Big Ones

TFT_Augment_BigSpender.desc: Your team gains @Value@% Attack Damage and Ability Power for every 1 gold in champion value on your board (Gold Value: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_BigSpender_Value@g).

TFT_Augment_BirthdayReunion.desc:
Gain @Gold@ gold. At Level @InitialLevelBreakpoint@, gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion. At Level @FirstLevelBreakpoint@, gain a Thief's Gloves. At Level @SecondLevelBreakpoint@, gain a random 2-star 5-cost champion.

Inkborn Fables Tactician's Crown, 2024
TFT_Augment_BirthdayReunion.name: Birthday Reunion

TFT_Augment_BlacksmithTraining.desc: Whenever you build an item, gain a completed item anvil instead. That anvil always offers the item built + @NumOptions@ other options. Gain a random component.

TFT_Augment_BlazingSoul.desc: Combat start: Your highest Attack Speed champion gains @AbilityPower@% Ability Power and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed. Repeat on another ally every @TransferDuration@ seconds.
TFT_Augment_BlazingSoul.name: Blazing Soul I

TFT_Augment_BlazingSoul2.desc: Combat start: Your highest Attack Speed champion gains @AbilityPower@% Ability Power and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed. Repeat on another ally every @TransferDuration@ seconds.
TFT_Augment_BlazingSoul2.name: Blazing Soul II

TFT_Augment_BloodRage.desc: Your allies gain @BaseDamageAmp*100@-@DamageAmpCap*100@% Damage Amp based on their missing Health. Maximum Damage Amp gained at @MissingHealthCap@% Health.
TFT_Augment_BloodRage.name: Blood Rage

TFT_Augment_BlossomingLotus1.desc: Your team's Abilities can critically strike. Every @Interval@ seconds, your team gains @IntervalCritChance*100@% Critical Strike Chance.
TFT_Augment_BlossomingLotus1.name: Blossoming Lotus I

TFT_Augment_BlossomingLotus2.desc: Your team's Abilities can critically strike. Every @Interval@ seconds, your team gains @IntervalCritChance*100@% Critical Strike Chance.
TFT_Augment_BlossomingLotus2.name: Blossoming Lotus II

TFT_Augment_BodyguardTraining.desc:
Allies gain @BaseResistGained@ Armor and Magic Resist, increased by @ResistsPerLevel@ per player level.

Gizmos & Gadgets Championship, 2022
TFT_Augment_BodyguardTraining.name: Bodyguard Training

TFT_Augment_BoosterPack.desc:
Gain @TotalValue@ gold of random champions. (At least one @GuaranteedCost@-cost guaranteed!)

(Each champion has a small chance of being holographic!)
TFT_Augment_BoosterPack.name: Booster Pack

TFT_Augment_BoosterPackPlus.desc:

TFT_Augment_BraggingRights.name: Bragging Rights

TFT_Augment_BranchingOutPlus.desc:
Gain a random Emblem and a Reforger.

Reforgers allow you to remake any item.
TFT_Augment_BranchingOutPlus.name: Branching Out+

TFT_Augment_BronzeForLife2.desc:
Your team gains @DamageAmpBonus*100@% Damage Amp and @Resists@ Armor and Magic Resist for each Bronze-tier trait.

Damage Amp: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_BronzeForLife_CurrentDamageAmp@%
Armor and Magic Resist: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_BronzeForLife_CurrentDurability@

TFT_Augment_BulkyBuddies1.name: Bulky Buddies I

TFT_Augment_BulkyBuddies2.desc: Allies that start combat next to exactly 1 other ally gain @HealthBonus@ Health. When that champion dies, the other gains a @ShieldAmount*100@% max Health Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

TFT_Augment_CategoryFive.desc: Gain a Runaan's Hurricane. Your Runaan's Hurricanes shoot @additionalbolts@ extra bolts, each dealing @TotalDamage*100@% of the original damage.

TFT_Augment_Changeling_GlamourItemTier1.desc:

TFT_Augment_ClimbTheLadder1.desc: Each time an ally dies, allies that share at least one trait with them gain @BonusAP@% Ability Power, @BonusAD*100@% Attack Damage, @BonusArmor@ Armor, and @BonusMR@ Magic Resist.

TFT_Augment_CloseQuarters.desc: Your back 2 rows are disabled, but your team gains [STATS TM].

TFT_Augment_CognitiveOverload.desc: Gain @Gold@ gold, @OneCostCount@ 2-star 1-cost champion, @TwoCostCount@ 2-cost champion, @ThreeCostCount@ 3-cost champions, @XP@ XP, and @FreeRolls@ Shop reroll.

TFT_Augment_Isekai_Strategist.desc: Summon a magical hero from another universe to fight for you. This hero is a Strategist this game.
TFT_Augment_Isekai_Strategist.name: Isekai

TFT_Augment_ItemCollector1.desc: For each unique item they are holding, your team gains @AD*100@% Attack Damage and @AP@% Ability Power.
TFT_Augment_ItemCollector1.name: Item Collector I

TFT_Augment_ItemCollector2.desc: Your team gains @BaseHP@ Health. For each unique item they are holding, your team gains bonus @Health@ Health, @AD*100@% Attack Damage, and @AP@% Ability Power.
TFT_Augment_ItemCollector2.name: Item Collector II

TFT_Augment_ItemCrownguard.desc: Gain a Crownguard. At @HealthThreshold*100@% Health, Crownguard's start of combat effect triggers again at @EffectMultiplier*100@% power.
TFT_Augment_ItemCrownguard.name: Second Coronation

TFT_Augment_ItemGargoyleStoneplate.desc: Gain a Gargoyle Stoneplate. Combat start: Allies holding Gargoyle Stoneplate gain @HealthIncrease*100@% max Health if they're the only one in their row.
TFT_Augment_ItemGargoyleStoneplate.name: Solo Plate

TFT_Augment_ItemKrakenSlayer.desc: Gain a Kraken's Fury. Allies holding Kraken's Fury apply a stack on their target every attack. Every third stack deals true damage equal to @PercentHPDamage@% of the target's max Health.
TFT_Augment_ItemKrakenSlayer.name: Press the Attack

TFT_Augment_ItemLadder.desc: Gain a temporary item that unequips and transforms at the start of each round. The item quality increases each Stage.
TFT_Augment_ItemLadder.name: Item Ladder

TFT_Augment_ItemRefresh.desc: Lose all completed items, and gain 2 random components for each item lost. Then gain @ComponentsToGive@ random components.
TFT_Augment_ItemRefresh.name: Item Refresh

TFT_Augment_ItemSpiritVisage.desc: Gain a Spirit Visage. Every @Frequency@ seconds, Spirit Visage heals allies within @HexRadius@ hex for @MissingHealth@% of their missing Health.
TFT_Augment_ItemSpiritVisage.name: Spirit of Redemption

TFT_Augment_JustHit.desc: Gain a Champion Duplicator, @NumRolls@ Shop rerolls, and @Gold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_JustHit.name: Just Hit

TFT_Augment_JustSlayer.desc: Gain a Giant Slayer. Giant Slayers gain their Damage Amp against all enemies instead of just Tanks.
TFT_Augment_JustSlayer.name: Indiscriminate Killer

TFT_Augment_KickStart.desc: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion and @Gold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_KickStart.name: Kick Start

TFT_Augment_Kingslayer.desc: Now and after every player combat, gain @Gold@ gold. If you win against a player who had more health than you, gain @WinBonusGold@ gold instead.
TFT_Augment_Kingslayer.name: Kingslayer

TFT_Augment_LastSecondSave.desc: The first time each ally falls below @HealthThreshold*100@% Health, they restore @HealPercent*100@% maximum Health.
TFT_Augment_LastSecondSave.name: Last Second Save

TFT_Augment_LateGameScaling.desc:
Gain @XPGain@ XP at the start of player combat rounds. Your 5-cost champions gain @BonusHealth*100@% Health and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

Cyber City Tactician's Crown, 2025
TFT_Augment_LateGameScaling.name: Late Game Scaling

TFT_Augment_LegionOfThrees.desc:
Gain a random Emblem. Your 3-cost champions and all allies equipped with an Emblem gain @HealthAmount@ Health and @AS*100@% Attack Speed.

Reckoning Championship, 2021
TFT_Augment_LegionOfThrees.name: Legion of Threes

TFT_Augment_LightningStrike.desc: After @StrikeDelay@ seconds, lightning strikes the enemy team dealing @MaxHealthDamage*100@% HP true damage and stunning for @StunDuration@ second.
TFT_Augment_LightningStrike.name: Lightning Strike

TFT_Augment_Lineup.desc: Your team gains @Resistances@ Armor and Magic Resist for each ally that starts combat in the front two rows.
TFT_Augment_Lineup.name: Lineup

TFT_Augment_LoneHero.desc: Your last surviving champion  gains @ASBonus*100@% Attack Speed and @DurabilityBonus*100@% Durability
TFT_Augment_LoneHero.name: Lone Hero

TFT_Augment_LuxurySubscription.desc:
Gain a package containing a 5-cost champion, a 2-star 1-cost champion, and @Gold@ gold.

At the start of the next @FutureChampionCount@ stages, gain the package again.
TFT_Augment_LuxurySubscription.name: Luxury Subscription

TFT_Augment_MagicRoll.desc:
Roll 3 dice. Gain rewards based on their total.

Reward: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_MagicRoll@
TFT_Augment_MagicRoll.name: A Magic Roll

TFT_Augment_MagicRollMinus.desc:
Roll a die. Gain rewards based on the number rolled.

Reward: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_MagicRoll@
TFT_Augment_MagicRollMinus.name: Slightly Magic Roll

TFT_Augment_Manaflow1.desc: Your allies that start combat in the back row gain @ManaPerAttack@ additional Mana per attack.
TFT_Augment_Manaflow1.name: Manaflow I

TFT_Augment_Manaflow2.desc: Your allies that start combat in the back row gain @ManaPerAttack@ additional Mana per attack.
TFT_Augment_Manaflow2.name: Manaflow II

TFT_Augment_MarksMan.desc: Your team gains @BaselineAD*100@% Attack Damage. Every @ProcDelay@ seconds, they gain @ADPerProc*100@% more.
TFT_Augment_MarksMan.name: Focused Fire

TFT_Augment_MarksmansToolbox.desc: Gain a Sniper's Focus. in @combatnum@ rounds, gain a Fishbones.
TFT_Augment_MarksmansToolbox.name: Marksman's Toolbox

TFT_Augment_MaxBuild.desc:
Gain a Champion Duplicator, @Gold@ gold, and your next shop contains 5 unique four-cost champions.

Galaxies Championship, 2020
TFT_Augment_MaxBuild.name: Max Build

TFT_Augment_MaxCap.desc: Your max level is 7. Gain @NumItems@ Tactician's Shield which increases your team size by +1, and @AugmentGold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_MaxCap.name: Max Cap

TFT_Augment_MayTheFoursBeWithYou.desc: Your 4-cost champions and Jhin gain @Health@ Health and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed. Gain a Jhin.
TFT_Augment_MayTheFoursBeWithYou.name: May the Fours Be With You

TFT_Augment_Mentorship1.desc: If an ally starts combat next to a higher-cost ally, it gains @AS*100@% Attack Speed and @Health@ Health.
TFT_Augment_Mentorship1.name: Mentorship I

TFT_Augment_Mentorship2.desc: If an ally starts combat next to a higher-cost ally, it gains @AS*100@% Attack Speed and @Health@ Health.
TFT_Augment_Mentorship2.name: Mentorship II

TFT_Augment_MinMaxer.desc:
Gain a Golden Item Remover and @NumItems@ random components.

Golden Item Remover is a Magnetic Remover with infinite uses.
TFT_Augment_MinMaxer.name: Min-Max

TFT_Augment_MirroredMonetization.desc:
Gain @GoldContained@ gold. For the next @Rounds@ rounds, enemy champions drop @PercCost@ gold when killed.

@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_MirroredMonetization_TotalGoldTooltip@
TFT_Augment_MirroredMonetization.name: Malicious Monetization

TFT_Augment_Misfits.desc:
Your team gains @Health@ Health for each active Unique trait. Gain a Rhaast and a Miss Fortune.

@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_Misfits_TotalHealthTooltip@

Unique traits belong to 1 champion and are shown in orange.
TFT_Augment_Misfits.name: Misfits

TFT_Augment_MoneyHungry.desc: Gain @InstantGold@ gold now, then @StageGold@ gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.
TFT_Augment_MoneyHungry.name: Money Hungry

TFT_Augment_MoneyHungryPlus.desc: Gain @InstantGold@ gold now, then @StageGold@ gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.
TFT_Augment_MoneyHungryPlus.name: Money Hungry+

TFT_Augment_MoneyMonsoon.desc: Gain @RoundGold@ gold now and every round for the rest of the game.
TFT_Augment_MoneyMonsoon.name: Money Monsoon

TFT_Augment_Moonlight.desc: Combat start: @NumUnits@ random 1-cost champion is upgraded to 3-star for that round and gains @ADBonus*100@% Attack Damage and @APBONUS@% Ability Power.
TFT_Augment_Moonlight.name: Moonlight

TFT_Augment_MuseumHeist.desc:
After @NumberOfCombats@ player combats, gain 1 of every item component. Gain a random component now.

@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_MuseumHeist_TooltipTRAKey@ @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_MuseumHeist_CompleteTRAKey@
TFT_Augment_MuseumHeist.name: Component Heist

TFT_Augment_NarrowMind.desc: For the rest of the game you have only have @NumBenchSlots@ bench slots, but your rerolls cost @RerollCost@g. Gain @Gold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_NarrowMind.name: Narrow Mind

TFT_Augment_NineLives.desc: Set your current and max player Health to @NumberOfLives@. On combat loss, you only lose @HealthLoss@ health and gain loot. You can't gain health.
TFT_Augment_NineLives.name: Nine Lives

TFT_Augment_NoScoutNoPivot.desc:
Champions that fight in player combat cannot be benched or sold. Your team gains @HPScale*100@% Health, and @APScale@% Attack Damage and Ability Power after player combat.

@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_NoScoutNoPivot_TrackerTRAKEY_Holder@
TFT_Augment_NoScoutNoPivot.name: NO SCOUT NO PIVOT

TFT_Augment_NobleSacrifice.desc: When your first ally dies each combat, grant your team @BaseResists@ + @SharePerc*100@% of that ally's Armor and Magic Resistance.
TFT_Augment_NobleSacrifice.name: Noble Sacrifice

TFT_Augment_OnTheHouse.desc: Whenever you star up a champion, gain @gold@ gold. Gain @augmentselectbonusgold@ gold now.
TFT_Augment_OnTheHouse.name: On The House

TFT_Augment_OneBuffTwoBuff.desc: Gain a Red Buff, a Blue Buff, and a Champion Duplicator.
TFT_Augment_OneBuffTwoBuff.name: One Buff, Two Buff

TFT_Augment_OopsAllRageblades.desc: All your current and future completed items transform into Guinsoo's Rageblades that grant @ResistStackValue@ Armor and Magic Resist. Every @AttacksPerStack@ Rageblade stacks grant @StackValue@% Attack Damage and Ability Power.
TFT_Augment_OopsAllRageblades.name: Anger Issues

TFT_Augment_Overheal.desc: Every third attack deals @BonusDamage*100@% damage and heals @PercentHeal*100@% of the damage. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to @MaxShield@ Health.
TFT_Augment_Overheal.name: Overheal

TFT_Augment_PIckEms.desc: In @NumRounds@ rounds, get up to @Gold@ gold based on how close you are to your current ranking in the lobby.
TFT_Augment_PIckEms.name: Guess Ahead

TFT_Augment_PairOfFours.desc: If your team has exactly @NumCopies@ 4-cost champions, they each gain @Health@ Health and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed. Gain a random 4-cost.
TFT_Augment_PairOfFours.name: Pair of Fours

TFT_Augment_PairOfFours_Set7.desc: If your team has exactly @NumCopies@ tier-4 champions, they each gain @Health@ Health and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed. Gain a random tier-4 champion.
TFT_Augment_PairOfFours_Set7.name: Pair of Fours

TFT_Augment_PandorasPocketLint.desc: Alternate between gaining a Magnetic Remover and Reforger every @NumRounds@ rounds. Gain a random component after every carousel.
TFT_Augment_PandorasPocketLint.name: Pandora's Pocket Lint

TFT_Augment_ParentingForDummies.desc: Gain a Training Dummy and @InitialGold@ gold. If it is the first to die each player combat, gain @Gold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_ParentingForDummies.name: Scapegoat

TFT_Augment_PatienceIsAVirtue.desc: Gain @InitialRerolls@ rerolls now. Each round, gain @FreeRerolls@ free rerolls if you did not buy a champion last round.
TFT_Augment_PatienceIsAVirtue.name: Patience is a Virtue

TFT_Augment_PerfectLoss.desc: When you win or lose combat by @UnitThreshold@ or fewer units, gain @GoldToGive@ gold next round.
TFT_Augment_PerfectLoss.name: Precise Planning

TFT_Augment_PetriciteArmorI.desc: Your team takes @ReducedAbilityDamage*100@% reduced damage from champion abilities.

TFT_Augment_PetriciteArmorII.desc: Your team takes @ReducedAbilityDamage*100@% reduced damage from champion abilities.
TFT_Augment_PetriciteArmorII.name: Petricite Armor II

TFT_Augment_PiercingLotus1.desc: Your team gains @critchance@% Critical Strike chance, and their Abilities can critically strike. Critical strikes @ShredSunderPerc*100@% Shred and Sunder the target for @Duration@ seconds.
TFT_Augment_PiercingLotus1.name: Piercing Lotus I

TFT_Augment_PiercingLotus2.desc: Your team gains @critchance@% Critical Strike chance, and their Abilities can critically strike. Critical strikes @ShredSunderPerc*100@% Shred and Sunder the target for @Duration@ seconds.
TFT_Augment_PiercingLotus2.name: Piercing Lotus II

TFT_Augment_Pilfer.desc: Each round, gain a 1-star copy of the first champion you killed last combat. The first time you gain @GoldRequired@ gold worth of champions in this way, gain a Thief's Gloves. @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_Pilfer_Tooltip@
TFT_Augment_Pilfer.name: Pilfer

TFT_Augment_Pirates3.desc: Your allies have a rare chance to drop treasure chests when they kill enemy champions.
TFT_Augment_Pirates3.name: Pirates

TFT_Augment_Placebo.desc: Your team gains @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed. Gain @Gold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_Placebo.name: Placebo

TFT_Augment_PlaceboPlus.desc: Your team gains @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed. Gain @Gold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_PlaceboPlus.name: Placebo+

TFT_Augment_PocketRecombobulator.desc: Get @NumRecombobulator@ Pocket Recombobulators, a consumable that transforms a 1 or 2-cost champion into one of a higher cost. They keep their Star level. Also receive @NumReforgers@ Reforgers.
TFT_Augment_PocketRecombobulator.name: Pocket Recombobulator

TFT_Augment_PowerUp.desc: Your next augment is one tier higher.
TFT_Augment_PowerUp.name: Augmented Power

TFT_Augment_PoweredByPain.desc: When your champions get a kill, they get 5 bonus mana per 100 overkill damage; this bonus increases with significant excess damage.
TFT_Augment_PoweredByPain.name: Powered By Pain

TFT_Augment_PreciseSmithing.desc:
Reforging items and Artifacts grants an anvil of the same value instead. Gain @NumComponents@ component and @NumReforger@ reforger now, and @StageReforger@ reforgers every stage.

Includes components and Radiant Items, but does not affect Emblems or Tactician's Items.

TFT_Augment_PrismaticDestiny.desc: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and @Gold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_PrismaticDestiny.name: Prismatic Destiny

TFT_Augment_PrismaticDestinyPlus.desc: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and @Gold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_PrismaticDestinyPlus.name: Prismatic Destiny+

TFT_Augment_PrismaticPipeline.desc: The next non-player combat round will drop an additional Prismatic Orb full of amazing loot.
TFT_Augment_PrismaticPipeline.name: Prismatic Pipeline

TFT_Augment_PromisedProtection.desc: Gain a Protector's Vow. Protector's Vow grants its holder @ManaPercent@% additional Mana from all sources.
TFT_Augment_PromisedProtection.name: Promised Protection

TFT_Augment_Protagonist.desc: Gain a random 1-cost Champion Augment. After @TurnDelay@ turns, gain a copy of the champion at the start of every turn.
TFT_Augment_Protagonist.name: Protagonist

TFT_Augment_PsychicForge.desc: Round start Completed Items on benched champions turn into one of their recommended items. Gain a random completed item.
TFT_Augment_PsychicForge.name: Psychic Forge

TFT_Augment_Pyromaniac.desc: Gain a Red Buff. Your Burns deal @BurnIncrease*100@% increased damage.
TFT_Augment_Pyromaniac.name: Pyromaniac

TFT_Augment_QualityOverQuantity.desc:
Champions holding exactly 1 item upgrade that item to Radiant. Champions holding Radiant items gain @BonusHealth*100@% Health. Gain @NumRemovers@ Magnetic Removers.

Thief's Gloves counts as multiple items.
TFT_Augment_QualityOverQuantity.name: Quality Over Quantity

TFT_Augment_QuestingHero.desc: The first time you field @NumChampsNeeded@ distinct unlockable champions in a player combat, gain a massive reward!
TFT_Augment_QuestingHero.name: Questing Hero

TFT_Augment_QuietQuitting.desc: For the next @NumRounds@ player combats, you cannot use your shop. After, gain @Gold@ gold and a Completed Item Anvil.
TFT_Augment_QuietQuitting.name: Quiet Quitting

TFT_Augment_RanduinsImmovableObject.desc: Gain a Randuin's Omen. Its range is increased by 1 hex and its effect is increased by @effectincrease*100@%.
TFT_Augment_RanduinsImmovableObject.name: Immovable Object

TFT_Augment_ReinforcedRejuvenation1.desc: Your team has @StatOmnivamp*100@% Omnivamp, increased by @BonusVampPer*100@% for every champion that starts combat in that same row.
TFT_Augment_ReinforcedRejuvenation1.name: Row Rejuvenation I

TFT_Augment_ReinforcedRejuvenation2.desc: Your team has @StatOmnivamp*100@% Omnivamp, increased by @BonusVampPer*100@% for every champion that starts combat in that same row.
TFT_Augment_ReinforcedRejuvenation2.name: Row Rejuvenation II

TFT_Augment_Replication.name: Replication

For every @AugmentRerollTracked@ unused Augment Reroll, gain @ShopRerollToGrant@ free shop rerolls. Gain @Gold@ gold.

Does not include the round this augment is selected.
TFT_Augment_RerollTransfer.name: Reroll Transfer

TFT_Augment_RestartMission.name: Restart Mission

TFT_Augment_RestartMissionPlus.desc: Delete all champions on your board and bench. Gain a random 2-star 4-cost, two 2-star 3-cost,  two 2-star 2-cost, and 2-star 1-cost champion.
TFT_Augment_RestartMissionPlus.name: Restart Mission +

TFT_Augment_Retribution.desc:
Gain @ItemCount@ Hands of Justice. Allies equipped with Hand of Justice gain Precision and @CritChance*100@% Critical Strike Chance.

{{TFT_Keyword_Precision}}
TFT_Augment_Retribution.name: Retribution

TFT_Augment_RiggedShop.desc: Your next shop and every @NumRolls@ shops will contain all 3-cost champions.
TFT_Augment_RiggedShop.name: Rigged Shop

TFT_Augment_RiggedShopPlus.desc: Your next shop and every @NumRolls@ shops will contain all 3-cost champions. Gain @Rerolls@ rerolls.
TFT_Augment_RiggedShopPlus.name: Rigged Shop+

TFT_Augment_SatedSpellweaver.desc: After casting an Ability, champions gain @Omnivamp*100@% Omnivamp for @Duration@ seconds. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to @MaxShield@ Health.
TFT_Augment_SatedSpellweaver.name: Sated Spellweaver

TFT_Augment_SavingsAccount.desc:
After you earn @GoldRequired@ gold in interest, gain @GoldToGain@ gold. Your max interest is increased to @InterestCap@. Gain @GoldNow@ gold now.

Gold earned: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_SavingsAccount_Tracker@
TFT_Augment_SavingsAccount.name: Savings Account

TFT_Augment_Scavenger.desc: The first @NumDeaths@ enemy champions that are killed each combat grant a champion on your team a temporary completed item.
TFT_Augment_Scavenger.name: Scavenger

TFT_Augment_SearchForTheYordleLord.desc: After upgrading @NumUpgrades@ champions to 3-star, gain a magnificent reward. Gain @NumStartUnits@ 1-cost champions.
TFT_Augment_SearchForTheYordleLord.name: An Upgraded Adventure

TFT_Augment_SeraphimsStaff.desc: Gain an Archangel's Staff. Archangel's Staff grants @IncreasedMana@ additional Mana Regen if its holder has @APThreshold@% or more Ability Power.
TFT_Augment_SeraphimsStaff.name: Seraphim's Staff

TFT_Augment_ShareTheSpotlight.desc: Gain a spotlight in the back corner of your board. All units in the spotlight gain @DamagePercent*100@% Damage Amp, @OmnivampPercent*100@% Omnivamp, and @ManaPerSecond@ Mana per second.
TFT_Augment_ShareTheSpotlight.name: Share the Spotlight

TFT_Augment_ShimmerscaleEssence.desc:
Gain a Mogul's Mail. In @combatnum@ rounds, gain a Gamblers Blade.

These items give gold as well as combat power.
TFT_Augment_ShimmerscaleEssence.name: Shimmerscale Essence

TFT_Augment_ShippingRoute.desc:
Every loot orb you open creates a copy in Treasure Portal, where they gain value each turn. Sell the Treasure Portal to open all the orbs inside. Gain several bonus orbs now.
Portal Value: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_ShippingRoute_Tracker@
TFT_Augment_ShippingRoute.name: Shipping Route

TFT_Augment_ShojinSpirit.desc: Your team gains @AD*100@% Attack Damage and @Mana@ Mana. Gain a B.F. Sword and a Tear of the Goddess.
TFT_Augment_ShojinSpirit.name: Spear's Will

TFT_Augment_ShopGlitch.desc: During non-player combat rounds, your shop refreshes for free every @RefreshTimer@ seconds for @TotalTimer@ seconds.
TFT_Augment_ShopGlitch.name: Shop Glitch

TFT_Augment_SideEffects.desc: When an ally is healed, they deal @HealConversionPct*100@% of the healing to their target as magic damage. Every @HealInterval@ seconds, allies heal for @HealPct*100@% of their max Health.
TFT_Augment_SideEffects.name: Side Effects

TFT_Augment_SilverDestiny.desc: Gain a random Silver Augment and @Gold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_SilverDestiny.name: Silver Destiny

TFT_Augment_SilverDestinyPlus.desc: Gain a random Silver Augment and @Gold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_SilverDestinyPlus.name: Silver Destiny+

TFT_Augment_SilverDestinyPlusPlus.desc: Gain a random Silver Augment and @Gold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_SilverDestinyPlusPlus.name: Silver Destiny++

TFT_Augment_SizeMatters.desc: Gain a Giant's Belt. After a champion starts combat with more than @HealthRequired@ max Health, gain a Warmog's Armor.
TFT_Augment_SizeMatters.name: Size Matters

TFT_Augment_SliceOfLife.desc: Twice per stage, gain a random champion. Its cost increases by Stage. This effect ends after receiving @Max5Costs@ 5-cost champion.
TFT_Augment_SliceOfLife.name: Slice of Life

TFT_Augment_SoloLeveling.desc: For the next @NumCombats@ combats, your team size is 1 but the champion you field has massively increased stats. Gain @XPPerKill@ XP for every kill they get. Afterwards, gain @NumComponents@ item components.
TFT_Augment_SoloLeveling.name: Solo Leveling

TFT_Augment_SpeedyDoubleKill.desc:

Fates Championship, 2021
TFT_Augment_SpeedyDoubleKill.name: Speedy Double Kill

TFT_Augment_Spellblades.desc: Whenever one of your champion casts, their next attack deals bonus magic damage equal to @abilitypower*100@% of their Ability Power.
TFT_Augment_Spellblades.name: Spellblades

TFT_Augment_SpellcastersToolbox.desc: Gain a Manazane. In @combatnum@ rounds, gain a Zhonya's Paradox.
TFT_Augment_SpellcastersToolbox.name: Spellcaster's Toolbox

TFT_Augment_Spellsword.desc: Every time an ally attacks @NumAttacks@ times, they gain @AbilityPower@ Ability Power.

TFT_Augment_SpiritLink2.desc: Champions restore @BaseRegenBonus*100@% of their max Health every @RegenPeriod@ seconds. Increase the healing by @RegenPerMissingHP@% for every 10 missing player Health.
TFT_Augment_SpiritLink2.name: Spirit Link II

TFT_Augment_Sponging.name: Sponging

TFT_Augment_SpreadingRootsPlus.desc: Gain @NumOfEmblems@ random Emblems, a Reforger, and @Gold@ gold.
TFT_Augment_SpreadingRootsPlus.name: Spreading Roots+

1-cost and 2-cost champions in your shop have a chance to be 2-star. Gain @Gold@ gold.

Chances increase with player level.

TFT_Augment_StarryNightPlus.desc:
1-cost and 2-cost champions in your shop have a chance to be 2-star. Gain @Gold@ gold.

Current Chances: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_StarryNight_Odds@%

Collect Golden Balls by defeating players in combat. Collect all @WinsPerReward@ for a reward, then restart the quest with more powerful rewards.
